Gamma di insalata: CHF220,500.00 - CHF409,500.00 Descrizione del lavoro #LI-Hybrid # Ubicazione: Basilea, Svizzera E se le offerte che form oggi potessero definire il futuro della salute? In qualità di Head BD&L Transactions, Immunology, sarai al centro del motore di crescita di Novartis, leader di partnership ad alto impatto che portano terapie trasformative a pazienti in tutto il mondo. Dalla ricerca iniziale alla commercializzazione, l'architetto e negoziare offerte complesse e globali, lavorando all'incrocio tra scienza, strategia e business. Questa è una rara opportunità per influenzare il nostro pipeline di immunologia, collaborare con i leader senior, e posizionare Novartis come partner di scelta in tutto il settore. Descrizione del lavoro Principali responsabilità
• Architetto e negozia complesse operazioni di licensing e partner in tutte le fasi di sviluppo
• Organizzare un accordo, sviluppare un foglio di termine e negoziare contratti con partner esterni
• Orchestrare i team interfunzionali per costruire casi aziendali forti e basati sui dati
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con la leadership di Therapeutic Area per allineare la strategia e le priorità
• Navigare processi di governance, presentando raccomandazioni chiare ai decisori senior
• Gestire gli stakeholder interni ed esterni per avanzare in modo efficiente e competitivo
• Monitorare il paesaggio esterno, identificare le opportunità di partner e l'attività competitiva
• Rafforzare e sfruttare una vasta rete industriale per sbloccare collaborazioni ad alto valore
• Campione Novartis come partner di scelta attraverso interazioni di impatto e l'esecuzione degli accordi Requisiti essenziali
• PhD in Scienza, idealmente combinato con un Master of Business Administration o equivalente
• Estensiva esperienza nello sviluppo aziendale, nel licensing o nel settore farmaceutico
• Provato record traccia di approvvigionamento, strutturazione, negoziazione e chiusura di contratti di partenariato complessi
• Profonda comprensione dello sviluppo della droga attraverso le fasi di ricerca, sviluppo e commercializzazione
• Forte esperienza di leadership gestendo team globali, interfunzionali e iniziative strategiche
• Ottima comunicazione e capacità di influenzare, con la capacità di coinvolgere dirigenti senior e partner esterni Si prega di presentare un foglio di contratto con chiara descrizione dell'accordo e la spiegazione del contributo con la vostra domanda. Vantaggi e premi A Novartis, ci impegniamo a riimmaginare insieme la medicina e a premiare le persone che lo fanno accadere. Campo d'insalatura annuale previsto per il ruolo: CHF 220.500 - 409.500 Lo stipendio base offerto è determinato sulla base di obiettivi di genere-neutral, come le competenze rilevanti, competenze e l'esperienza in conformità con la politica di impostazione della retribuzione Novartis e dopo l'adesione Novartis saranno esaminati periodicamente. Le ricompense di far parte del nostro team vanno ben oltre la retribuzione base e gli incentivi. Offriamo anche una varietà di vantaggi competitivi in genere per aiutare a prosperare personalmente e professionalmente, come piani di assicurazione, piani di pensionamento, risorse di benessere e programmi di riconoscimento globale. Inoltre, forniamo opzioni di lavoro flessibili e ibride, dove possibile, e minimo 14 settimane congedo parentale pagato. Oltre al tuo stipendio base, potresti essere idoneo per un bonus basato sulle prestazioni a seconda di determinati parametri di prestazione. I premi azionari a lungo termine concessi a livello di gruppo possono anche essere parte del vostro pacchetto. Ulteriori dettagli saranno forniti durante il processo di applicazione. Leggi la nostra brochure per saperne di più sulla nostra offerta globale di premi totali: https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf Nota: i benefici e i risarcimenti possono variare per paese e sono soggetti a requisiti legali locali, comprese le disposizioni di contratti collettivi, ove applicabile. Una panoramica completa del vostro pacchetto di compensazione, compresi i dettagli relativi del contratto collettivo applicabile al vostro ruolo in base alla vostra posizione di lavoro e l'entità del datore di lavoro Novartis, sarà comunicata separatamente a voi durante

Salary Range:
CHF220,500.00 - CHF409,500.00

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland

What if the deals you shape today could define the future of healthcare? As Head BD&L Transactions, Immunology, you’ll be at the heart of Novartis’ growth engine—leading high-impact partnerships that bring transformative therapies to patients worldwide. From early research to commercialization, you’ll architect and negotiate complex, global deals, working at the intersection of science, strategy, and business. This is a rare opportunity to influence our immunology pipeline, collaborate with senior leaders, and position Novartis as a partner of choice across the industry.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Architect and negotiate complex licensing and partnering transactions across all development stages

• Drive deal structuring, term sheet development, and contract negotiations with external partners

• Orchestrate cross-functional teams to build strong, data-driven business cases

• Partner closely with Therapeutic Area leadership to align on strategy and priorities

• Navigate governance processes, presenting clear recommendations to senior decision-makers

• Manage internal and external stakeholders to advance deals efficiently and competitively

• Monitor external landscape, identifying partnering opportunities and competitive activity

• Strengthen and leverage an extensive industry network to unlock high-value collaborations

• Champion Novartis as a partner of choice through impactful interactions and deal execution

Essential Requirements

• PhD in Science, ideally combined with a Master of Business Administration or equivalent

• Extensive experience in business development, licensing, or investment banking within the pharmaceutical industry

• Proven track record of sourcing, structuring, negotiating, and closing complex partnership deals

• Deep understanding of drug development across research, development, and commercialization stages

• Strong leadership experience managing global, cross-functional teams and strategic initiatives

• Excellent communication and influencing skills, with ability to engage senior executives and external partners

Please submit a deal sheet with clear description of the deal and explanation of contribution with your application.

Benefits & Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: CHF 220.500 - 409.500

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters. Long-term equity awards granted at group level may also be part of your package. Further details will be provided during the application process.

Read our brochure to learn more about our global total rewards offering:
https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf

Note: Benefits and compensation may vary by country and are subject to local legal requirements, including provisions of collective bargaining agreements where applicable. A full overview of your compensation package, including any relevant collective bargaining agreement details applicable to your role based on your employment location and Novartis employer entity, will be communicated separately to you during

Gehaltsbereich: CHF220.500.00 - CHF409.500.00 Stellenbeschreibung Zusammenfassung #LI-Hybrid Standort: Basel, Schweiz Was wäre, wenn die Deals, die Sie heute gestalten, die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens definieren könnten? Als Head BD & L Transactions, Immunology, stehen Sie im Mittelpunkt des Wachstumsmotors von Novartis - führende Partnerschaften mit hoher Wirkung, die Patienten weltweit transformative Therapien anbieten. Von der frühen Forschung bis zur Kommerzialisierung werden Sie komplexe, globale Geschäfte entwerfen und verhandeln und an der Schnittstelle von Wissenschaft, Strategie und Geschäft arbeiten. Dies ist eine seltene Gelegenheit, unsere Immunologie-Pipeline zu beeinflussen, mit leitenden Führungskräften zusammenzuarbeiten und Novartis als bevorzugten Partner in der gesamten Branche zu positionieren. Stellenbeschreibung Hauptzuständigkeiten
• Erstellen und Aushandeln komplexer Lizenz- und Partnertransaktionen in allen Entwicklungsphasen
• Deal-Strukturierung, Term Sheet-Entwicklung und Vertragsverhandlungen mit externen Partnern vorantreiben
• Orchestrieren Sie funktionsübergreifende Teams, um starke, datengesteuerte Geschäftsfälle zu erstellen
• Enge Partnerschaft mit der Führung des Therapeutic Area zur Ausrichtung auf Strategie und Prioritäten
• Navigieren Sie durch Governance-Prozesse und präsentieren Sie klare Empfehlungen für leitende Entscheidungsträger
• Verwalten Sie interne und externe Stakeholder, um Transaktionen effizient und wettbewerbsfähig voranzutreiben
• Überwachung der externen Landschaft, Ermittlung von Partnermöglichkeiten und Wettbewerbsaktivitäten
• Stärkung und Nutzung eines umfangreichen Branchennetzwerks zur Erschließung hochwertiger Kooperationen
• Champion Novartis als Partner der Wahl durch wirkungsvolle Interaktionen und Transaktionsausführung Grundlegende Anforderungen
• PhD in Science, ideal kombiniert mit einem Master of Business Administration oder gleichwertig
• Umfangreiche Erfahrung in Business Development, Lizenzierung oder Investment Banking in der Pharmaindustrie
• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei Beschaffung, Strukturierung, Verhandlung und Abschluss komplexer Partnerschaftsabkommen
• Tiefes Verständnis der Arzneimittelentwicklung über Forschungs-, Entwicklungs- und Vermarktungsstufen hinweg
• Starke Führungserfahrung im Management globaler, funktionsübergreifender Teams und strategischer Initiativen
• Hervorragende Kommunikation und beeinflussende Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, Führungskräfte und externe Partner zu engagieren Bitte reichen Sie ein Deal Sheet mit einer klaren Beschreibung des Deals und einer Erklärung des Beitrags mit Ihrer Bewerbung ein. Vorteile & Belohnungen Bei Novartis setzen wir uns dafür ein, die Medizin gemeinsam neu zu gestalten - und die Menschen zu belohnen, die sie ermöglichen. Erwartete Jahresgrundgehaltsspanne für Rollen: CHF 220.500 - 409.500 Das angebotene Grundgehalt wird auf der Grundlage von geschlechtsneutralen Zielen wie relevanten Fähigkeiten, Kompetenzen und Erfahrungen gemäß der Lohnpolitik von Novartis festgelegt und wird nach dem Beitritt von Novartis regelmäßig überprüft. Die Belohnungen, Teil unseres Teams zu sein, gehen weit über Grundlohn und Anreize hinaus. Wir bieten auch eine Vielzahl von Wettbewerbsvorteilen an, die Ihnen helfen, persönlich und professionell zu gedeihen, wie Versicherungspläne, Altersvorsorgepläne, Wohlbefindensressourcen und globale Anerkennungsprogramme. Darüber hinaus bieten wir flexible und hybride Arbeitsmöglichkeiten, wo möglich, und mindestens 14 Wochen bezahlten Elternurlaub. Zusätzlich zu Ihrem Grundgehalt haben Sie möglicherweise Anspruch auf einen leistungsbezogenen Bonus, der von bestimmten Leistungsparametern abhängt. Langfristige Aktienprämien, die auf Gruppenebene gewährt werden, können ebenfalls Teil Ihres Pakets sein. Weitere Details werden während des Bewerbungsprozesses angegeben. Lesen Sie unsere Broschüre, um mehr über unser globales Gesamtprämienangebot zu erfahren: https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf Hinweis: Leistungen und Entschädigungen können von Land zu Land variieren und unterliegen lokalen gesetzlichen Anforderungen, einschließlich der Bestimmungen von Tarifverträgen, sofern anwendbar. Eine vollständige Übersicht über Ihr Vergütungspaket, einschließlich aller relevanten Tarifvertragsdetails, die für Ihre Rolle auf der Grundlage Ihres Beschäftigungsstandorts und Ihrer Arbeitgebereinheit von Novartis gelten, wird Ihnen während des gesamten Zeitraums separat mitgeteilt.

Échelle salariale : 220,500,00 CHF - 409,500,00 CHF Sommaire de la description d'emploi #LI-Hybrid Lieu: Bâle, Suisse Que faire si les accords que vous formez aujourd'hui pourraient définir l'avenir des soins de santé? En tant que responsable des transactions BD&L, Immunology, vous serez au cœur du moteur de croissance Novartis, leader de partenariats à fort impact qui apportent des thérapies de transformation aux patients du monde entier. Des premiers travaux de recherche à la commercialisation, vous êtes l'architecte et négociez des accords complexes et mondiaux, travaillant à l'intersection de la science, de la stratégie et des affaires. C'est une occasion rare d'influencer notre pipeline d'immunologie, de collaborer avec des dirigeants et de positionner Novartis comme partenaire de choix dans l'industrie. Description de l'emploi Principales responsabilités
• Architecte et négocie des opérations complexes de concession de licences et de partenariat à toutes les étapes du développement
• Encourager la structuration des ententes, l'élaboration de fiches de termes et la négociation de contrats avec des partenaires externes
• Ordonner des équipes interfonctionnelles pour construire des analyses de rentabilisation solides et axées sur les données
• Collaborer étroitement avec le leadership du secteur thérapeutique pour s'aligner sur la stratégie et les priorités
• Naviguer dans les processus de gouvernance, présenter des recommandations claires aux décideurs supérieurs
• Gérer les intervenants internes et externes pour faire avancer les ententes de façon efficace et concurrentielle
• Surveiller le paysage externe, identifier les possibilités de partenariat et les activités concurrentielles
• Renforcer et exploiter un vaste réseau industriel pour débloquer des collaborations de grande valeur
• Champion Novartis en tant que partenaire de choix par des interactions impactées et l'exécution de la transaction Exigences essentielles
• Doctorat en sciences, idéalement combiné avec une maîtrise en administration des affaires ou équivalent
• Expérience approfondie dans le développement des entreprises, l'octroi de licences ou la banque d'investissement dans l'industrie pharmaceutique
• Expérience éprouvée de l'approvisionnement, de la structuration, de la négociation et de la conclusion de contrats de partenariat complexes
• Compréhension approfondie du développement des médicaments à tous les stades de la recherche, du développement et de la commercialisation
• Forte expérience de leadership dans la gestion d'équipes et d'initiatives stratégiques mondiales et interfonctionnelles
• Excellente communication et influence des compétences, avec la capacité d'engager des cadres supérieurs et des partenaires externes Veuillez soumettre une feuille d'entente avec une description claire de l'entente et une explication de la contribution avec votre demande. Avantages et récompenses À Novartis, nous nous engageons à réinventer la médecine ensemble - et à récompenser les gens qui y arrivent. Échelle de salaire de base annuelle prévue pour le rôle : CHF 220.500 - 409.500 Le salaire de base offert est déterminé en fonction d'objectifs non sexistes, tels que les compétences, les compétences et l'expérience pertinentes conformément à la politique d'établissement de la rémunération de Novartis et lors de son adhésion à Novartis sera examiné périodiquement. Les récompenses de faire partie de notre équipe vont bien au-delà du salaire de base et des incitatifs. Nous offrons également une variété d'avantages concurrentiels en nature pour vous aider à prospérer personnellement et professionnellement, tels que les régimes d'assurance, les régimes de retraite, les ressources de bien-être et les programmes de reconnaissance mondiale. De plus, nous offrons des options de travail flexibles et hybrides, si possible, et un congé parental rémunéré minimum de 14 semaines. En plus de votre salaire de base, vous pourriez être admissible à une prime basée sur le rendement selon certains paramètres de rendement. Les bourses à long terme accordées au niveau du groupe peuvent également faire partie de votre forfait. Des détails supplémentaires seront fournis pendant le processus de demande. Lisez notre brochure pour en savoir plus sur notre offre globale de récompenses : https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf Note : Les avantages sociaux et l'indemnisation peuvent varier selon les pays et sont assujettis aux exigences juridiques locales, y compris les dispositions des conventions collectives, le cas échéant. Un aperçu complet de votre trousse de rémunération, y compris tous les détails pertinents de la convention collective applicable à votre rôle en fonction de votre lieu d'emploi et de l'entité employeur de Novartis, vous sera communiqué séparément pendant

descriptionByLocale.it:
Job Description Summary This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the Hiring Manager. Job Description The Strategy, Platforms & Transformation team is dedicated to enabling improved decision-making at Novartis by leveraging data and advanced analytics capabilities to generate actionable insights that drive business growth. We work within the US business, bringing insights and challenging ideas to empower smarter, data-driven decision-making. This role is crucial in driving AI transformation by bringing the best in AI and tech to unlock opportunities for growth and improve patient outcomes. The Director, AI Forward Deployed Engineer will lead the design, development, deployment, and ongoing optimization of agentic AI solutions embedded within business functions to address high value use cases and accelerate transformation. This role is responsible for guiding engineering efforts that convert existing processes, products, and services into agentic AI products and intelligent workflows, ensuring solutions are practical, scalable, and aligned with business needs. The ideal candidate combines strong engineering leadership, solution delivery experience, and cross functional collaboration skills to shape technical approaches, oversee implementation, and drive operational performance for deployed AI solutions. Working closely with business stakeholders, product leaders, platform teams, data partners, and technology teams, this role will help ensure agentic AI solutions are effectively integrated into real world environments, deliver measurable outcomes, and continuously improve based on user feedback and operational insights. Major Accountabilities
• Lead the design, development, deployment, and support of agentic AI solutions for business specific use cases and workflows.
• Partner with business stakeholders, product teams, and domain experts to understand requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
• Oversee day to day engineering execution for forward deployed AI initiatives, including planning, prioritization, delivery, and operational readiness.
• Ensure AI solutions are scalable, reliable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise architecture, engineering standards, and governance requirements.
• Drive integration of AI solutions with business systems, data sources, and operational processes to enable effective end to end workflows.
• Monitor solution performance, user feedback, and operational outcomes to identify enhancements, resolve issues, and support continuous improvement.
• Collaborate with platform, data, infrastructure, and security teams to leverage shared capabilities and ensure compliant, efficient deployment.
• Communicate progress, technical decisions, risks, and business impact to senior leaders and cross functional stakeholders. Essential Requirements:
• A Bachelor degree required and advanced degree preferred, ideally in business, engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field.
• 8 plus years of AI engineering experience, with a strong track record of leading product strategy, roadmap development, and delivery for complex digital, data, or AI enabled products.
• Demonstrated experience in AI and data driven product environments, including translating business needs into scalable product solutions and partnering closely with technical teams to bring innovative products to market.
• Strong cross functional leadership skills, with proven ability to collaborate effectively across Engineering, Innovation, Design, Data Science, Commercial, and other business teams to drive alignment and execution.
• Experience managing and developing product managers or junior product leaders, including coaching, prioritization support, and fostering strong product management practices.
• Excellent

Job Description Summary
LI#- Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland

As a Therapeutic Area Biomarker Lead (TABL) in the Biomarker Development (BMD) group, you are accountable for defining and delivering biomarker strategies for the Immunology portfolio across multiple drug development programs in early and late clinical stages. You are accountable to translate the preclinical mechanistic understanding into an indication-relevant biomarker strategy, a clinical fit-for-purpose biomarker plan, oversee the integration into the clinical protocol, and lead the scientific and strategic discussions in project teams and governance meetings. As such you are a key member of global project teams, lead the Biomarker and Diagnostic teams, engage in Translational Data Science teams, and provide scientific, strategic, and tactical input aligned to the portfolio.

In the late phase particularly, you will be expected to assume the overall accountability for the biomarker strategy for at least one of our portfolio assets.

Furthermore, you will be leading overarching asset-related biomarker strategies enabling the delivery of late phase assets and respective launches.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

• BMD scientific, strategic and tactical leader at project level driving impactful biomarker strategies and supporting biomarker plan excellence with concise communication in project teams and governance meetings.

• Accountable for the biomarker strategy at a project, indication and study level in coordination with the respective clinical study lead and biomarker study expert.

• Lead a dedicated matrixed group of biomarker subject matter experts and project team representatives to align key stakeholders on the biomarker strategy and biomarker plan at the project and study level and across the portfolio.

• Accountable for the concept, endorsement, implementation, delivery and contextualization of the biomarker strategy.

• Contextualizes biomarker results and disseminates conclusions to external audiences via abstracts and/or peer-reviewed publications.

• Co-leads strategic translational data science working groups focused on integrating large-scale molecular and clinical patient data sets to identify novel indications, patient subgroups, and endpoints to enable decision-making.

• Providing thought leadership with other BMD TABLs to identify synergies and drive innovation across our large and diverse clinical portfolio in immunology and general medicine.

• Representing BMD on early and late Disease Area Initiatives or Consortia to identify, develop, and drive disease and compound mechanistic biology, clinical decision-making exploratory biomarkers and precision medicine hypotheses for the portfolio.

• Implementing strategies in close collaboration with the BMD global organization which includes over 100 associates with expertise in all aspects of biomarker science i.e. genetics, genomics, molecular and cellular, digital devices, imaging and data sciences.

Essential Requirements:

• PhD degree in Life Sciences required

• Experience in industry (Pharma or Biotech) for at least 5+ years, working on Clinical Trials.

• Scientific excellence in immunological diseases in the translational and biomarker spaces.

• Relevant expertise utilizing biomarkers for clinical decision-making including pharmacodynamics, clinical efficacy, disease deconvolution, response characterization, patient stratification and/or precision medicine.

• Evidence of interpreting and disseminating omics related findings, e.g. genetics, genomics, proteomics, with relevant application to clinical decision making while partnering with key stakeholders from research, data sciences and clinical development.

• Scientific excellence supported by recognized high quality publications

• Experience performing similar role within a pharmaceutical/biotechnology research company, clinical research organization or academic medical cent

Titre de l'emploi interne : Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) Data42

À propos du rôle :
Le Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) de Data42 est un chef de file technique intégré qui collabore directement avec les équipes de domaine pour transformer des problèmes de grande valeur en données de travail et applications d'IA. Vous allez rapidement prototyper, itérer et produire des solutions sur la fonderie de Palantir, les utilisateurs de passerelle, les produits et l'ingénierie de plate-forme pour fournir des résultats mesurables. Ce rôle combine l'ingénierie logicielle, l'ingénierie des données et la résolution de problèmes axés sur les produits, l'accent étant mis sur l'adoption du flux de travail des utilisateurs et la durabilité opérationnelle.

Description de l'emploi
Principales responsabilités :

• Livraison intégrée et résolution de problèmes : Intégré avec des équipes de domaine pour comprendre les flux de travail, définir les critères de succès et traduire les besoins en capacités expédiées; Découverte de plomb, cadrage de solution et livraison itérative du prototype à la production.

• Build on Palantir Foundry : Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions de bout en bout dans Foundry , y compris les pipelines de données, les transformations, l'alignement de l'ontologie et les workflows d'application ; Configurer et optimiser les applications basées sur Foundry pour soutenir la prise de décision opérationnelle et l'analyse répétable; Appliquer les modèles Foundry-native pour les permissions, l'auditabilité, la performance et la gestion des rejets.

• Ingérer, transformer et modéliser divers ensembles de données pour les rendre utilisables et fiables pour l'analyse et les applications; Définir les contrôles de la qualité des données et s'assurer que les ensembles de données sont adaptés à l'usage prévu (hypothèses et limites relatives aux documents).

• Développement et intégration d'applications : Développer des applications orientées vers l'utilisateur ou des expériences de flux de travail et s'intégrer avec les systèmes en amont et en aval au besoin; Soutenir le déploiement, le suivi et l'amélioration continue des applications de production.

• Leadership interfonctionnel : S'associer étroitement avec les gestionnaires de produits, les data savants, les ingénieurs de données, la gouvernance et les équipes de plateforme pour aligner la portée, les délais et les normes; Communiquer clairement les compromis et débloquer l'exécution grâce à l'influence technique et des intervenants.

• Activer et réutiliser : Créer des modèles, des composants et des modèles réutilisables pour accélérer les futures livraisons dans Data42; Les coéquipiers mentors et contribuer à la documentation interne, aux livres de lecture et aux normes de livraison.

• Expérience démontrée en fournissant des logiciels, des données ou des produits d'analyse dans un environnement rapide, orienté vers l'utilisateur, avec une expertise en prototypage rapide à l'exécution de la production.

• Bonnes compétences en programmation et confort dans les couches de données et d'application.

• Forte empathie de l'utilisateur et orientation du workflow, avec la capacité prouvée de travailler directement avec les utilisateurs finaux, clarifier les exigences ambiguës, et livrer itérativement.

• Excellentes compétences en communication et en gestion des intervenants, avec une grande fiabilité et discipline opérationnelle.

Exigences souhaitables:

Data42 is Novartis’ enterprise data and AI platform, bringing together clinical, research, and real world data to power advanced analytics and accelerate the discovery and development of innovative medicines.

You are a driven, self-motivated leader, who will help us. In addition, the role is responsible for the anonymization of patient data to enable secondary research while safeguarding privacy and compliance requirements. This role acts as the Deputy EDO and co-leads the Biomedical Research (BR) Governance Board in partnership with the Head of Data / EDO to drive effective data governance and decision-making.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement data governance policies and standards for BR, ensuring consistency, integrity, and compliance across the organization

• Partner with the Head of Data and Platform to embed data governance principles into technology solutions, including “data governance as code”

• Lead the anonymization of Novartis patient-level data to enable compliant secondary research use on Data42

• Collaborate closely with the Head of Data on enterprise data management (EDM) activities

• Support the execution of the BR data strategy by ensuring alignment with business and data governance requirements

• Excellent theoretical and profound scientific knowledge in analytical areas in biologic drug development

• Proficiency in English

Job Description Summary
Location: Basel, Switzerland #onsite

Role Purpose:
At Novartis, we are reimagining medicine to improve and extend people's lives. We discover and develop breakthrough treatments and find new ways to bring cures to as many people as possible. Without safe, easy-to-use, high-quality drug delivery devices our patients could not get their medicines. This is where you come in, the Device Technology Solution Center is looking for a Senior Design Engineer for the development of drug device combination products.

The aim is to develop a new auto-injector platform from early phase development to market launch.

Job Description
Your Responsibilities:

Your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Work on platform device development and participate to project activities in cross-functional teams to deliver easy-to-use, safe and robust products

• Contribute to the complete development process of medical devices: ideation, brainstorming, prototyping, piloting, manufacturing and complaint handling

• Create and review IP

• Work with CAD, 3D, drawings, tolerance analysis

• Size and specify plastic and metallic components

• Work with third party suppliers, including prototyper, tool makers, CMOs

• Manage testing and characterization for acceptance, compliance, performance etc., and implement improvements

• Perform root cause analysis and develop robust solutions to prevent re-occurrence

• Ensure components are delivered and controlled to the required quality for clinical trials and commercial production

• Author key design history file documents: design input requirements, component specifications and design verification documents.

Role Requirements

• Degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent

• Preferably 10 years of experience in medical device development

• Proficient oral communication and excellent technical writing skills in English is a must

• Experience in designing plastic and metal components; tolerance analysis; metrology; lab testing

• Experience in material qualification

• Good knowledge in design for manufacturing and assembly

• Good knowledge of key regulations and standards

• Track record in Design History File documentation

• Ability to interact with cross functional team in matrix organization

• Minimum 80% on site work – 4 days/week

Gamma di insalata: CHF122,500.00 - CHF227,500.00 Descrizione del lavoro Come Lead Delivery per Lab Automation & Logistics in Data & Digital (D&D), guiderai la consegna e l'adozione di soluzioni all'avanguardia per l'automazione, l'orchestrazione e l'intelligenza artificiale nelle operazioni di laboratorio e nella logistica dei campioni in Biomedical Research. Si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nel trasformare il modo in cui i flussi di lavoro scientifici vengono eseguiti consentendo ambienti di laboratorio scalabili, efficienti e basati sui dati che accelerano i risultati della ricerca. Descrizione del lavoro Titolo del lavoro interno: Associate Director Posizione: Basilea, CH, in loco. #LI-onsite Questo ruolo ha sede a Basilea, CH. Novartis non è in grado di offrire il supporto di trasferimento per questo ruolo: si prega di applicare solo se questa posizione è accessibile per voi. Il ruolo si concentra sulla creazione e il miglioramento di processi end-to-end automatizzati e scalabili in ambienti di laboratorio, dati e logistica. La consegna avviene attraverso iniziative prevedibili, di alta qualità e tempestive, allineate alle priorità aziendali e agli standard architettonici. Il Delivery Lead è strumentale nella priorità, nella pianificazione e nell'esecuzione di iniziative in tutto il ciclo di vita dall'ideazione al rilascio, alla scaling e alla transizione alle operazioni, garantendo al contempo l'allineamento con gli standard architettonici, di sicurezza e di conformità. Il ruolo gioca un ruolo centrale nel consentire la creazione di valore innovativo per la ricerca biomedica attraverso una efficace leadership di consegna, il pensiero concentrico del flusso di lavoro e un forte impegno degli stakeholder. Ambito di responsabilità Il ruolo opera nelle seguenti aree di funzionalità:
• Dispositivo di laboratorio e integrazione del sistema
• Orchestrazione del flusso di lavoro attraverso sistemi e team
• Automazione (RPA, flussi di lavoro organizzativi)
• Soluzioni AI per processi operativi
• Flussi di ordinazione, produzione e logistica del campione
• Progettazione ed esecuzione dei flussi di lavoro compatibili Responsabilità chiave:
• Consegna end-to-end di iniziative di automazione del laboratorio e di orchestrazione del flusso di lavoro, guidando processi di laboratorio ed efficienti e scalabili in tutta la ricerca biomedica
• Assicurare l'eccellenza della consegna gestendo la portata, le linee temporali e il budget, mentre i principali team di matrice interfunzionali e l'allineamento tra le parti interessate e le funzioni D&D
• Automazione del flusso di lavoro tramite l'identificazione di inefficienze e la traduzione di processi aziendali in soluzioni di automazione scalabili e riutilizzabili (RPA, orchestrazione, AI)
• Impegno dei propri stakeholder agendo come interfaccia primaria, costruendo relazioni forti, allineando le priorità e comunicando i progressi, i rischi e i risultati chiaramente
• Garantire la conformità e gli standard garantendo soluzioni conformi ai requisiti di architettura, sicurezza e regolamentazione, e allineare con le piattaforme aziendali e le esigenze di integrità dei dati Requisiti essenziali:
• Master o PhD in un campo scientifico/tecnologico/scientifico computazionale/scienza dati.
• 10+ anni di esperienza rilevante in un ambiente multidisciplinare nel continuum Pharma.
• comprovata capacità di fornire iniziative complesse end-to-end, ottenendo risultati di alta qualità nel tempo e all'interno del budget attraverso laboratori, dati, o domini digitali
• Forte competenza di gestione dei progetti, tra cui priorità, pianificazione, esecuzione, comunicazione e gestione dei rischi, con la capacità di gestire le dipendenze in più team e sistemi
• Esperienza dimostrata leader di team di matrice interfunzionali, con la capacità di coordinare efficacemente diversi stakeholder e guidare l'esecuzione allineata
• Ottimi capacità di gestione e comunicazione degli stakeholder, con la capacità di agire come partner di consegna affidabile in ambito aziendale e tecnico
• Competenze solide e digitali, compresa la comprensione delle operazioni di laboratorio e dei sistemi scientifici, e la conoscenza pratica dell'automazione del flusso di lavoro, RPA e soluzioni AI
• Forte mentalità di pensiero e automazione dei sistemi, con la capacità di identificare le opportunità di ottimizzazione e applicare approcci appropriati (orchestrazione flusso di lavoro, RP

Job Description Summary
As a Delivery Lead for Lab Automation & Logistics in Data & Digital (D&D), you will drive the delivery and adoption of cutting-edge automation, orchestration, and AI-enabled solutions across laboratory operations and sample logistics in Biomedical Research.

You will play a pivotal role in transforming how scientific workflows are executed enabling scalable, efficient, and data-driven lab environments that accelerate research outcomes.

Job Description

Internal job title: Associate Director
Position Location : Basel, CH, onsite. #LI-onsite

This role is based in Basel, CH. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support for this role: please only apply if this location is accessible for you.

The role focuses on creating and improving automated, and scalable end-to-end processes across lab, data, and logistics environments. Delivery is performed through predictable, high-quality, and timebound initiatives, aligned with enterprise priorities and architectural standards. The Delivery Lead is instrumental in prioritizing, planning, and executing initiatives across the full lifecycle from ideation to release, scaling, and transition to operations while ensuring alignment with architectural, security, and compliance standards. The role plays a central part in enabling innovative value creation for Biomedical Research through effective delivery leadership, workflow-centric thinking, and strong stakeholder engagement.

Scope of Responsibility

The role operates across the following capability areas:

• Lab device and system integration

• Workflow orchestration across systems and teams

• Automation (RPA, event-driven workflows)

• AI solutions for operational processes

• Sample ordering, production, and logistics workflows

• Compliance-enabled workflow design and execution

Key responsibilities:

• Lead end-to-end delivery of lab automation and workflow orchestration initiatives, driving scalable and efficient lab and logistics processes across Biomedical Research

• Ensure delivery excellence by managing scope, timelines, and budget while leading cross-functional matrix teams and aligning across stakeholders and D&D functions

• Drive workflow automation by identifying inefficiencies and translating business processes into scalable, reusable automation solutions (RPA, orchestration, AI)

• Own stakeholder engagement by acting as the primary interface, building strong relationships, aligning priorities, and communicating progress, risks, and outcomes clearly

• Guarantee compliance and standards by ensuring solutions meet architectural, security, and regulatory requirements, and align with enterprise platforms and data integrity needs

Essential Requirements :

• Masters or PhD degree in a scientific/technology/computational science/data science area.

• 10+ years of relevant experience in a multidisciplinary environment across the Pharma continuum.

• Proven ability to deliver complex initiatives end-to-end, consistently achieving high-quality outcomes on time and within budget across lab, data, or digital domains

• Strong project management expertise, including prioritization, planning, execution, communication, and risk management, with the ability to manage dependencies across multiple teams and systems

• Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional matrix teams, with the ability to effectively coordinate diverse stakeholders and drive aligned execution

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to act as a trusted delivery partner across business and technical audiences

• Solid domain and digital expertise, including understanding of lab operations and scientific systems, and hands-on knowledge of workflow automation, RPA, and AI-enabled solutions

• Strong systems thinking and automation mindset, with the ability to identify optimization opportunities and apply appropriate approaches (workflow orchestration, RP

• Starkes Projektmanagement-Know-how, einschließlich Priorisierung, Planung, Ausführung, Kommunikation und Risikomanagement, mit der Fähigkeit, Abhängigkeiten über mehrere Teams und Systeme hinweg zu verwalten

Le rôle joue un rôle central dans la création de valeur innovatrice pour la recherche biomédicale par le biais d'un leadership efficace en matière d'exécution, d'une réflexion centrée sur les flux de travail et d'un engagement fort des intervenants. Job Description Summary We offer two 6-month legal traineeship positions in Legal for Corporate Functions, one starting on January 1, 2027, and one starting on June 1, 2027! Job Description Are you interested in pursuing a career in law? We have the perfect opportunity for you! Our legal trainee position offers excellent hands-on, in-house legal experience within the dynamic and multinational environment of a leading pharmaceutical company. More than 70’000 unique individuals work at Novartis, all with different needs and aspirations, aligned to a single inspirational purpose: to Reimagine Medicine for millions of patients around the world. We are seeking a motivated and diligent legal trainee who has the courage to navigate in unknown and ambiguous legal areas and has the curiosity to learn and being exposed to interesting and challenging new legal questions. If you're passionate about making a difference and keen to kickstart your career with our in-house team, this could be the ideal role for you. We offer two 6-month legal traineeship positions in Legal for Corporate Functions, one starting on January 1, 2027, and one starting on June 1, 2027. Your responsibilities include:
• You'll be the backbone of our Legal team, offering essential advice in employment law (including questions related to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion), as well as litigation and investigation. You'll have the opportunity to tackle complex global and local issues, transforming challenges into solutions.
• You'll get your hands on practical tasks, managing individual legal cases, but also major projects (e.g. related to reorganizations, divestments, implementation of new policies and processes, artificial intelligence, etc.), drafting and reviewing agreements, internal regulations, and templates. This is your chance to shift from theory to practical application, making an immediate impact.
• Your role will involve in-depth legal research and the creation of legal memoranda, helping us to break down complex ideas into digestible insights. Here, your knowledge will fuel our mutual success. What you’ll bring to the role:
• Swiss Bachelor of Law (BLaw) und Master of Law (MLaw); master degree needs to be completed before start date
• Excellent proficiency in English and German, both in verbal and written communication
• High motivation and ability to work independently on challenging tasks and projects
• Prior legal internship and knowledge in employment law is a plus Are you ready to sharpen your skills and inspire change? If you're excited to contribute and learn, apply now, and submit a cover letter that includes your motivation for the position and your availability regarding the two traineeships (i.e. starting date January 1, 2027 or June 1, 2027). Descrizione del lavoro
#LI-Hybrid #
Ubicazione: Basilea, Svizzera
Questo ruolo ha sede a Basilea, in Svizzera. Novartis non è in grado di offrire il supporto di trasferimento per questo ruolo. Si prega di applicare solo se questa posizione è accessibile per voi.

Sei pronto a plasmare la strategia di qualità dietro alcune delle medicine più innovative del mondo? Come Global Head CQA Development Unit, svolgerai un ruolo di leadership fondamentale nell'intersezione dello sviluppo clinico, della sicurezza dei pazienti e dell'eccellenza normativa. Conducendo un team globale di professionisti della qualità clinica, si guida la supervisione strategica della qualità attraverso programmi di sviluppo complessi, consentendo approcci di qualità per design che accelerano l'innovazione, salvaguardando la conformità, l'integrità dei dati e il benessere dei pazienti. Questa è un'opportunità unica per influenzare le decisioni aziendali critiche, partner con leader senior in Novartis, e contribuire a portare trattamenti trasformativi a pazienti in tutto il mondo.

Descrizione del lavoro
Responsabilità chiave:

• Guidare e sviluppare un team globale di Leader del Programma di Qualità Clinica, promuovendo una cultura di qualità ad alte prestazioni.

• Definire ed eseguire la strategia di qualità per le unità di sviluppo assegnate, garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali.

• Fornire una supervisione strategica della qualità attraverso i programmi di sviluppo clinico per supportare il successo normativo e la sicurezza dei pazienti.

• Partner con gli stakeholder senior per identificare, mitigare e aumentare i rischi di qualità negli studi globali.

• Prontezza di ispezione campione e supporto di qualità di piombo per le ispezioni di regolazione, audit e attività di bonifica.

• Promuovere iniziative di miglioramento continuo che rafforzino la conformità, l'eccellenza operativa e i principi di qualità-by-design.

• Influenza mentalità organizzativa di qualità incorporando pratiche proattive di gestione del rischio e di governance della qualità.

Requisiti essenziali:

• Laurea avanzata in Scienze della Vita, Medicina, Farmacia, o una disciplina scientifica correlata.

• Ampia esperienza di sviluppo clinico, garanzia di qualità, farmacovigilanza, o ambienti sanitari regolamentati.

• Prove esperienze di leadership costruire, sviluppare e leader team globali all'interno di una complessa organizzazione matrice.

• Profonda comprensione dei processi di sperimentazione clinica end-to-end e dei requisiti normativi globali per la ricerca clinica.

• Dimostrato successo gestione di programmi ad alta complessità e influenzare gli stakeholder senior attraverso le funzioni.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione, negoziazione e problem solving con la capacità di guidare la collaborazione a livello globale.

Vantaggi e premi

A Novartis, ci impegniamo a riimmaginare insieme la medicina e a premiare le persone che lo fanno accadere.

Oltre al tuo stipendio base, potresti essere idoneo per un bonus basato sulle prestazioni a seconda di determinati parametri di prestazione.
Le ricompense di far parte del nostro team vanno ben oltre la retribuzione base e gli incentivi. Offriamo anche una varietà di vantaggi competitivi in genere per aiutare a prosperare personalmente e professionalmente, come piani di assicurazione, piani di pensionamento, risorse di benessere e programmi di riconoscimento globale. Inoltre, forniamo opzioni di lavoro flessibili e ibride, dove possibile, e minimo 14 settimane congedo parentale pagato.
Oltre al tuo stipendio base, potresti essere idoneo per un bonus basato sulle prestazioni a seconda di determinati parametri di prestazione. I premi azionari a lungo termine concessi a livello di gruppo possono anche essere parte del vostro pacchetto. Ulteriori dettagli saranno forniti durante il processo di applicazione.

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland
This role is based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support for this role. Please only apply if this location is accessible for you.

Are you ready to shape the quality strategy behind some of the world's most innovative medicines? As Global Head CQA Development Unit, you will play a pivotal leadership role at the intersection of clinical development, patient safety, and regulatory excellence. Leading a global team of Clinical Quality professionals, you will drive strategic quality oversight across complex development programs, enabling quality-by-design approaches that accelerate innovation while safeguarding compliance, data integrity, and patient well-being. This is a unique opportunity to influence critical business decisions, partner with senior leaders across Novartis, and help bring transformative treatments to patients worldwide.

Job Description
Key responsibilities:

• Lead and develop a global team of Clinical Quality Program Leads, fostering a high-performance quality culture.

• Define and execute the quality strategy for assigned Development Units, ensuring alignment with business objectives.

• Provide strategic quality oversight across clinical development programs to support regulatory success and patient safety.

• Partner with senior stakeholders to identify, mitigate, and escalate quality risks across global studies.

• Champion inspection readiness and lead quality support for regulatory inspections, audits, and remediation activities.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen compliance, operational excellence, and quality-by-design principles.

• Influence organizational quality mindset by embedding proactive risk management and quality governance practices.

Essential Requirements:

• Advanced degree in Life Sciences, Medicine, Pharmacy, or a related scientific discipline.

• Extensive experience in clinical development, quality assurance, pharmacovigilance, or regulated healthcare environments.

• Proven leadership experience building, developing, and leading global teams within a complex matrix organization.

• Deep understanding of end-to-end clinical trial processes and global regulatory requirements for clinical research.

• Demonstrated success managing high-complexity programs and influencing senior stakeholders across functions.

• Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills with the ability to drive collaboration globally.

Benefits & Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: 133,700.00 - 248,300.00 CHF

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.
In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters. Long-term equity awards granted at group level may also be part of your package. Further details will be provided during the application process.

Stellenbeschreibung Zusammenfassung
#LI-Hybrid
Standort: Basel, Schweiz
Diese Rolle hat ihren Sitz in Basel, Schweiz. Novartis kann für diese Rolle keine Umzugsunterstützung anbieten. Bitte bewerben Sie sich nur, wenn dieser Standort für Sie zugänglich ist.

Sind Sie bereit, die Qualitätsstrategie hinter einigen der weltweit innovativsten Medikamente zu gestalten? Als Global Head CQA Development Unit spielen Sie eine zentrale Führungsrolle an der Schnittstelle von klinischer Entwicklung, Patientensicherheit und regulatorischer Exzellenz. Führen Sie ein globales Team von Fachleuten für klinische Qualität, werden Sie die strategische Qualitätsaufsicht über komplexe Entwicklungsprogramme hinweg vorantreiben und qualitätsorientierte Ansätze ermöglichen, die Innovationen beschleunigen und gleichzeitig Compliance, Datenintegrität und das Wohlbefinden der Patienten gewährleisten. Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, kritische Geschäftsentscheidungen zu beeinflussen, mit leitenden Führungskräften in Novartis zusammenzuarbeiten und Patienten weltweit transformative Behandlungen zu bieten.

Stellenbeschreibung
Hauptzuständigkeiten:

• Führen und entwickeln Sie ein globales Team von Leads des Clinical Quality Program und fördern Sie eine Hochleistungskultur.

• Definieren und Ausführen der Qualitätsstrategie für zugewiesene Entwicklungseinheiten, um die Ausrichtung auf die Geschäftsziele sicherzustellen.

• Bereitstellung einer strategischen Qualitätsaufsicht über klinische Entwicklungsprogramme, um den regulatorischen Erfolg und die Patientensicherheit zu unterstützen.

• Zusammenarbeit mit hochrangigen Stakeholdern, um Qualitätsrisiken in globalen Studien zu identifizieren, zu mindern und zu eskalieren.

• Champion Inspektionsbereitschaft und leitende Qualitätsunterstützung für regulatorische Inspektionen, Audits und Sanierungsaktivitäten.

• Förderung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungsinitiativen zur Stärkung von Compliance, operativer Exzellenz und qualitätsorientierten Prinzipien.

• Beeinflussen Sie die organisatorische Qualitätshaltung, indem Sie proaktives Risikomanagement und Qualitäts-Governance-Praktiken integrieren.

Grundlegende Anforderungen:

• Fortgeschrittener Abschluss in Life Sciences, Medizin, Pharmazie oder einer verwandten wissenschaftlichen Disziplin.

• Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der klinischen Entwicklung, Qualitätssicherung, Pharmakovigilanz oder regulierten Gesundheitsumgebungen.

• Bewährte Führungserfahrung beim Aufbau, der Entwicklung und der Leitung globaler Teams innerhalb einer komplexen Matrixorganisation.

• Tiefes Verständnis von End-to-End-Prozessen klinischer Studien und globalen regulatorischen Anforderungen für die klinische Forschung.

• Nachgewiesener Erfolg bei der Verwaltung hochkomplexer Programme und der Beeinflussung leitender Stakeholder in allen Funktionen.

#LI-Hybrid
Lieu: Bâle, Suisse

Êtes-vous prêt à façonner la stratégie de qualité derrière certains des médicaments les plus innovants au monde? En tant que chef mondial de l'unité de développement de l'AQC, vous jouerez un rôle de leadership central à l'intersection du développement clinique, de la sécurité des patients et de l'excellence réglementaire. Dirigez une équipe mondiale de professionnels de la qualité clinique, vous dirigerez la surveillance stratégique de la qualité dans le cadre de programmes de développement complexes, permettant des approches de qualité par conception qui accélèrent l'innovation tout en préservant la conformité, l'intégrité des données et le bien-être des patients. C'est une occasion unique d'influencer les décisions d'affaires critiques, de s'associer avec des dirigeants de l'ensemble de Novartis et d'apporter des traitements transformatifs aux patients du monde entier.

Description de l'emploi
Principales responsabilités :

• Diriger et développer une équipe mondiale de responsables de programmes de qualité clinique, en favorisant une culture de qualité de haute performance.

• Définir et exécuter la stratégie de qualité pour les unités de développement affectées, en assurant l'alignement avec les objectifs opérationnels.

• Assurer une surveillance stratégique de la qualité dans l'ensemble des programmes de développement clinique afin d'appuyer le succès réglementaire et la sécurité des patients.

• Établir des partenariats avec des intervenants de haut niveau afin d'identifier, d'atténuer et d'accroître les risques de qualité dans toutes les études mondiales.

• Préparation des champions à l'inspection et soutien à la qualité pour les inspections réglementaires, les vérifications et les activités d'assainissement.

• Mener des initiatives d'amélioration continue qui renforcent la conformité, l'excellence opérationnelle et les principes de qualité par conception.

• Influencer l'état d'esprit de la qualité organisationnelle en intégrant des pratiques proactives de gestion du risque et de gouvernance de la qualité.

Exigences essentielles:

Translational Medicine Discovery & Profiling (TMDP) is a group of physicians and clinical researchers who drive innovative science from discovery to the patient through the selection, profiling, and early clinical development of medicines. Medical directors oversee phase 1 first-in-human (FiH) and phase 2 proof-of-concept (PoC) and dose range finding (DRF) studies in support for Phase 3 development. Medical directors in translational medicine are key and highly visible members of global cross-functional project teams that design and implement early research and discovery projects. Medical directors in translational medicine collaborate with colleagues in biology and chemistry to identify targets in diseases with significant unmet medical needs and provide input on likely clinical development pathways, design clinical development plans in collaboration with late phase development, draft clinical trial protocols and serve as medical leads for these trials. As a Medical Director in Translational Medicine Gastroenterology, you will report to the TM Head.

Il ruolo Il responsabile globale della tecnologia e dell'architettura nella ricerca biomedica (BR) punterà la nostra strategia informatica nella scoperta di farmaci e nello sviluppo clinico precoce, assicurando che le nostre tecnologie siano allineate ai nostri obiettivi, promuovendo l'unità e la cooperazione con i principali partner interni ed esterni, trasformando i nostri laboratori globali in ambienti ad alta produttività, con oceanografia. Incorporando la generazione di ipotesi "lab a secco" con la validazione robotica "wet lab," costruirete il "Self-Driving Lab" del futuro.

Il leader sarà membro del team di direzione della ricerca biomedica
• Data & Digital Leadership Team e un membro matrice del team di direzione dei dati, del digitale e dell'IT (DDIT) che rappresenta le esigenze della ricerca biomedica; il ruolo sarà riportato nel capo responsabile dei dati e del digitale BR e lavorerà a stretto contatto con il team di direzione dei dati e del digitale.

Cerchiamo un responsabile globale della tecnologia e dell'architettura, forte dal punto di vista imprenditoriale e tecnico, per guidare la strategia, il design e l'evoluzione delle nostre piattaforme Data & A.I. di nuova generazione e dei futuri endeavor a sostegno della nostra organizzazione globale di ricerca biomedica.

- Guidare la strategia, la progettazione e l'evoluzione delle nostre piattaforme di dati e AI di nuova generazione a sostegno di un'organizzazione globale di ricerca biomedica e definire una visione pluriennale e una tabella di marcia per le piattaforme di dati e AI di ricerca, garantendo l'allineamento con le priorità scientifiche e la strategia di AI digitale.

- contribuire in modo significativo alla creazione di una strategia digitale globale per la scoperta di farmaci a base di A.I. di BR, utilizzando Data Science, (Gen) A.I. e ML, da parte della tecnologia, e partecipare a importanti progetti e iniziative strategiche di condivisione incrociata e digitale per garantire la compatibilità senza soluzione di continuità dei sistemi di dati e delle soluzioni nelle unità di ricerca e sviluppo e commerciale di Novartis. - Guidare il laboratorio della futura iniziativa da una prospettiva informatica insieme ad esperti di automazione e attrezzature di laboratorio provenienti da altre funzioni BR.

- Collaborare strettamente con la comunità di dati DDIT e BR Data Science per elaborare ed eseguire la strategia digitale e AI per BR per garantire BR è un'organizzazione di ricerca pienamente abilitato AI. - Evaluare le tecnologie emergenti (flussi di lavoro agentici, database vettoriali, infrastrutture GPU, tecnologie di digitalizzazione di laboratorio, quantum computing ecc.) e tradurle in capacità pratiche che guidano i risultati della ricerca; Lead platform architecture reviews e orientare la selezione tecnologica.

- fornire un contributo strategico e una visione sulle tecnologie al presidente della ricerca e alla leadership scientifica di BR.. e fungere da consulente riconosciuto per la gestione dei vertici. - collaborare strettamente con le funzioni DDIT per garantire che le soluzioni aziendali siano utilizzate in modo preferenziale, ove possibile, e cercare sinergie; Se I.V. come ponte tra ingegneri, scienziati della R&S, data science, e gruppi IT di sicurezza/conformità e infrastrutture.

- Crescere e guidare un team diversificato, inclusivo, ad alte prestazioni e instillare una mentalità collaborativa, imprenditoriale, e sviluppare e mentore ad alte prestazioni, diversi team di ingegneri di piattaforme, ingegneri software, specialisti di dominio, e architetti, tecnologi di laboratorio.

Un background che dimostra una forte base in tecnologia e data science. - Proven esperienza in tecnologie e iniziative di architettura leader in una ricerca o in un ambiente farmaceutico. - Capacità dimostrativa di guidare iniziative strategiche e allinearli con obiettivi aziendali. - Forte leadership e competenze di gestione del team, con esperienza in mentoring e lo sviluppo di team ad alte prestazioni.

- Ottima capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder, con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente con team interfunzionali e leadership senior. - Proficienza nelle tecnologie di data science, AI e machine learning, con una profonda comprensione della loro applicazione nella scoperta di farmaci e nello sviluppo clinico precoce. - Esperienza nella valutazione e selezione delle tecnologie emergenti e nella loro traduzione in capacità pratiche. - Forte capacità di risoluzione dei problemi e la capacità di pensare in modo critico e creativo per guidare l'innovazione e il miglioramento.

- Capacità di lavorare in un'organizzazione a matrice e collaborare efficacemente con più stakeholder. - Fluenza in inglese, con forti capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale.

Interner Stellentitel Global Head BR Technologie, Stiftungen & Architektur

Über die Rolle Der Global Head of Technology & Architecture in Biomedical Research (BR) wird unsere Informationstechnologiestrategie in der Arzneimittelentdeckung und frühen klinischen Entwicklung voranbringen, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Technologien mit unseren Zielen abgestimmt sind und gleichzeitig die Einheit und Zusammenarbeit mit wichtigen internen und externen Partnern fördern, indem wir unsere globalen Labore in hochdurchsatzfähige, KI-orchestrated Umgebungen verwandeln.Durch die Integration von "trockenem Labor" Hypothesengenerierung mit "naßlabor" robotischer Validierung bauen Sie das "Selbst-Driving Lab" der Zukunft.

Der Leiter wird Mitglied des Data & Digital Leadership Teams der Biomedical Research und ein matrixiertes Mitglied des Data, Digital und IT (DDIT) Führungsteams sein, das die Bedürfnisse der Biomedical Research repräsentiert. Die Rolle berichtet in den Chief Data & Digital Officer, BR und wird eng mit dem Data and Digital Leadership Team zusammenarbeiten.

Wir suchen einen unternehmerischen und technisch starken Global Head of Technology & Architecture, der die Strategie, das Design und die Entwicklung unserer Data & AI-Plattformen der nächsten Generation und des Labors der Zukunft leitet und unsere globale biomedizinische Forschungsorganisation unterstützt.

Wichtige Aufgaben - Liefern Sie Spitzenforschungsinformatik, um die Entdeckung neuer Behandlungen mit Hilfe von Daten und digitaler Technologie zu beschleunigen und die Benutzererfahrung unserer Forscher zu verbessern. - Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Entwicklung der Technologiefähigkeiten von BR, zugrunde liegende Architektur, Antriebs- oder Kaufentscheidungen für Softwareprodukte und Architektur in enger Abstimmung mit DDIT, um harmonisierte, skalierbare, durchgängige Ansätze in Projekten zu liefern.

- Führen Sie die Strategie, das Design und die Entwicklung unserer nächsten Generation von Data & AI-Plattformen, die eine globale biomedizinische Forschungsorganisation unterstützen, und definieren Sie mehrjährige Visionen und Roadmaps für die Forschungsdaten- und KI-Plattformen, die eine Abstimmung mit wissenschaftlichen Prioritäten und der digitalen KI-Strategie gewährleisten.

- Ein wesentlicher Beitrag zur Schaffung einer globalen digitalen Strategie für die KI-getriebene Drogenentdeckung von BR mit Data Science, (Gen) AI und ML auf dem Technologieteil, und nehmen an wichtigen strategischen bereichsübergreifenden Daten- und digitalen Projekten und Initiativen teil, um die nahtlose Kompatibilität von Datensystemen und -lösungen in den Novartis Research-Development- und Commercial Units zu gewährleisten. - Das Labor der zukünftigen Initiative aus Informatik-Perspektive mit Laborgeräten und Automatisierungsexperten aus anderen BR-Funktionen zu treiben.

- Eng mit Novartis DDIT und der BR Data Science Gemeinschaft zusammenarbeiten, um die digitale und KI Strategie für BR zu entwickeln und umzusetzen, um sicherzustellen, dass BR eine voll KI-fähige Forschungsorganisation ist. - Neue Technologien (agentische Workflows, Vektordatenbanken, GPU-Infrastruktur, Labor-Digitalisierungstechnologien, Quanten-Computing etc.) zu bewerten und in praktische Fähigkeiten zu übersetzen, die Forschungsergebnisse vorantreiben; Lead-Plattform Architektur Bewertungen und Steuerung Technologieauswahl.

- Geben Sie dem Präsidenten der Forschungs- und BR-Wissenschaftsführerschaft strategische Inputs und Visionen zu Technologien und fungieren Sie als anerkannte Beraterin für Spitzenmanagement. - Partner in enger Zusammenarbeit mit DDIT-Funktionen, um sicherzustellen, dass Unternehmenslösungen wo möglich bevorzugt eingesetzt werden und Synergien suchen; dienen Sie als Brücke zwischen Ingenieurwesen, FuE-Wissenschaftlern, Datenwissenschaft und IT-Sicherheit/Compliance und Infrastrukturgruppen.

- Wachsen und führen Sie ein vielfältiges, inklusives, leistungsstarkes Team und vermitteln Sie eine kooperative, unternehmerische Denkweise, entwickeln und betreuen Sie ein leistungsstarkes, vielfältiges Team von Plattformingenieuren, Softwareingenieuren, Domain-Spezialisten und Architekten, Labortechnologen.

Grundlegende Anforderungen - Doktor oder Master, Abschluss in Informatik, Datenwissenschaft, KI, Computerbiologie, Cheminformatik oder einer verwandten Disziplin. Ein Hintergrund, der eine starke Grundlage in Technologie und Datenwissenschaft demonstriert. - Bewährte Erfahrung in führenden Technologie- und Architekturinitiativen in der Forschung oder Pharmazie. - Nachweis der Fähigkeit, strategische Initiativen zu fördern und sie mit Geschäftszielen auszurichten. - Starke Führungs- und Teammanagement-Fähigkeiten, mit Erfahrung in der Mentoring und Entwicklung von leistungsstarken Teams.

- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv mit cross-funktionalen Teams und Führungskräften arbeiten. - Kompetenz in der Datenwissenschaft, KI und maschinellem Lernen Technologien, mit einem tiefen Verständnis ihrer Anwendung in der Arzneimittelentdeckung und frühen klinischen Entwicklung. - Erfahrung bei der Bewertung und Auswahl von neuen Technologien und Übersetzung in praktische Fähigkeiten. - Starke Problemlösung Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, kritisch und kreativ zu denken, um Innovation und Verbesserung zu treiben.

- Fähigkeit, in einer matrixierten Organisation zu arbeiten und effektiv mit mehreren Stakeholdern zusammenzuarbeiten. - Fluency in Englisch, mit starken schriftlichen und verbalen Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

Titre interne du poste Responsable mondial BR Technologie, fondations et architecture

À propos du rôle Le responsable mondial de la technologie et de l'architecture en recherche biomédicale (BR) dirigera notre stratégie de technologie de l'information en matière de découverte de médicaments et de développement clinique précoce, en veillant à ce que nos technologies soient alignées sur nos objectifs tout en favorisant l'unité et la coopération avec des partenaires internes et externes clés, en transformant nos labs mondiaux en environnements à haut débit et à base d'IA.

Le chef de file sera membre de l'équipe de leadership en matière de données et de numérique de la recherche biomédicale et membre de l'équipe de leadership en matière de données, de numérique et de TI (DDIT) qui représente les besoins de la recherche biomédicale.

Nous recherchons un chef mondial de la technologie et de l'architecture, qui soit techniquement fort et entrepreneurial, pour diriger la stratégie, la conception et l'évolution de nos plateformes de nouvelle génération Data & AI et lab des efforts futurs en faveur de notre organisme mondial de recherche biomédicale.

Principales responsabilités - Fournir une informatique de recherche de premier ordre pour accélérer la découverte de nouveaux traitements utilisant la technologie numérique et des données et améliorer l'expérience utilisateur de nos chercheurs. - Assurer l'évolution des capacités technologiques de BR, de l'architecture sous-jacente, de la prise de décisions ou de l'achat de produits logiciels et de l'architecture en alignement étroit avec DDIT pour offrir des approches harmonisées, évolutives et de bout en bout à l'ensemble des projets.

- Dirigez la stratégie, la conception et l'évolution de nos plateformes de données et d'IA de nouvelle génération qui soutiennent une organisation mondiale de recherche biomédicale et définissez une vision et une feuille de route pluriannuelles pour les plateformes de données et d'IA de recherche, en assurant l'alignement sur les priorités scientifiques et la stratégie numérique en matière d'IA.

- Contribuer de façon significative à la création d'une stratégie numérique mondiale pour la découverte de médicaments par BR à l'aide de Data Science, (Gen) AI et ML dans le domaine de la technologie, et participer à des projets stratégiques transsectoriels de données et de données numériques et à des initiatives visant à assurer une compatibilité harmonieuse des systèmes et des solutions de données dans les unités de recherche-développement et commerciales de Novartis. - Diriger la tâche de l'initiative future dans une perspective informatique en collaboration avec les experts en équipement et en automatisation des laboratoires d'autres fonctions de BR.

- Collaborer étroitement avec Novartis DDIT et la communauté des sciences de la données BR pour concevoir et exécuter la stratégie numérique et de l'IA pour la BR afin de s'assurer que la BR est une organisation de recherche pleinement habilitée à l'IA. - Évaluer les technologies émergentes (processus de travail des agents, bases de données vectorielles, infrastructure GPU, technologies de numérisation des labs, calcul quantique, etc.) et les traduire en capacités pratiques qui conduisent aux résultats de la recherche.

- Fournir des contributions stratégiques et une vision sur les technologies au président de la recherche et au leadership scientifique de BR et agir comme conseiller reconnu auprès de la haute direction. - S'associer étroitement aux fonctions de DDIT pour s'assurer que les solutions d'entreprise sont déployées de préférence dans la mesure du possible et pour rechercher des synergies; servir de lien entre les ingénieurs, les scientifiques en R-D, les sciences des données et les groupes de sécurité/conformité des TI et des infrastructures.

- Développer et diriger une équipe diversifiée, inclusive et performante et instiller une mentalité collaborative et entrepreneuriale, et développer et encadrer une équipe diversifiée et performante d'ingénieurs de plateformes, d'ingénieurs de logiciels, de spécialistes de domaines et d'architectes, de technologues en lab.

Exigences essentielles - PhD ou maîtrise, diplôme en informatique, sciences des données, IA, biologie informatique, chimie ou discipline connexe. Un bagage qui démontre une solide base en technologie et sciences des données. - Expérience éprouvée dans les initiatives technologiques et architecturales de pointe dans un contexte de recherche ou de pharmacie. - Capacité démontrée de conduire des initiatives stratégiques et de les aligner sur les objectifs opérationnels. - Compétences solides en leadership et en gestion d'équipe, avec expérience en mentorat et en développement d'équipes à haut rendement.

- Excellentes compétences en communication et en gestion des intervenants, avec la capacité de travailler efficacement avec des équipes interfonctionnelles et des cadres supérieurs. - Compétence en sciences des données, en technologies de l'IA et en apprentissage automatique, avec une compréhension approfondie de leur application dans la découverte de médicaments et le développement clinique précoce. - Expérience dans l'évaluation et la sélection des technologies émergentes et dans leur traduction en capacités pratiques. - Fortes compétences en résolution de problèmes et la capacité de penser de façon critique et créative pour stimuler l'innovation et l'amélioration.

- Capacité de travailler dans une organisation matricielle et de collaborer efficacement avec de multiples intervenants. - Connaissance de l'anglais, avec de solides compétences en communication écrite et verbale.

Role Purpose:
We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Expert Analytical Scientist with experience in Oligonucleotides analytics to join our Analytical Research & Development (ARD) team. ARD is part of the Technical R&D Department within Development and plays a pivotal role in the characterization and analysis of Drug Substances and Drug Products throughout the transition from discovery to commercial production.

Job Description
Major accountabilities:

• Independently design, plan, execute, interpret, and report analytical activities for Oligonucleotides (DS and DP) utilizing cutting-edge analytical sciences and technologies (such as analytical method development, validation, transfer, stability, release testing, and formulation development analytics) in accordance with established timelines and quality standards. This position requires active participation in laboratory operations.

• Proactively identify scientific, technological and GMP challenges, propose creative solutions and communicate key issues to the Analytical Project Leader or respective technical project team.

• Foster and share best practices, provide robust scientific and technical expertise within the analytical project team, among analytical scientists, and throughout the organization.

• Create analytical documents that align with global project strategies by phase. Assist in strategic planning, design, and execution. Write & review analytical documents (e.g analytical methods, specifications, validation reports, stability report, batch records for stability and release testing) and align the corresponding activities within the project team.

• Participate to the planning and implementation of laboratory experiments for designated projects, including activity scheduling, experiment monitoring, and data analysis.

• Offer scientific guidance and mentorship to laboratory associates.

• Oversee technical analytical deviations, investigations of OOS, OOE, OOT. Recommend appropriate corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs).

• Provide valuable input to the analytical CMC documents and support regulatory submissions.

• Assist with audits and health authority inspections, making sure there are no major findings in the areas assigned.

• Follow SOPs, GMP, GLP, QM, HSE, ISRM, and Novartis Guidelines.

• Demonstrate excellent collaboration and encourage sharing of expertise.
