descriptionByLocale.it:
Salary Range: CHF93,800.00 - CHF174,200.00 Job Description Summary
• Location: Basel - Onsite
• #LI-Onsite
• Novartis cannot offer relocation for this role, please apply if this location is accessible to you. About Us: Novartis Biomedical Research (BR) is the innovation engine of Novartis—where deep disease biology meets bold therapeutic innovation. In Oncology Drug Discovery Biology, we translate a precise understanding of cancer mechanisms into new therapeutic concepts and modalities. We are seeking a Ph.D.-level scientist with a strong track record in cancer biology to join our Oncology Research team in Basel, lead a laboratory, and help discover the next generation of oncology medicines for patients with high unmet medical need. About this job: You will bring deep cancer biology expertise to generate, shape, and test bold new ideas for oncology drug discovery. Working with scientific peers and cross-functional partners, you will define and execute cutting-edge experimental strategies, generate high-quality data, validate targets and concepts, establish relevant cellular assays, and support the optimization and characterization of new molecular entities toward clinical proof of concept. Success in this role will require strong hands-on expertise in molecular and cell biology, rigorous experimental thinking to drive the mechanistic dissection of intracellular and cell surface targets, the ability to leverage bioinformatics and genome- and proteome-wide technologies to answer key biological questions, and knowledge in cutting-edge modalities and assays in emerging spaces such as Induced Proximity. Why Join Us: At Novartis, you will grow as a scientist and leader while contributing to high-impact oncology projects. This role offers the opportunity to expand your expertise, build new skills, take on increasing responsibility, and help project teams advance breakthrough science with the potential to improve patients’ lives. Job Description
• Major accountabilities include:
• · Lead a Drug Discovery Biology laboratory, guiding, supervising, and developing scientific associates to deliver high-quality experimental science.
• · Apply rigorous statistical thinking to large-scale datasets or other pertinent sources to identify new biological insights and therapeutic opportunities.
• · Design and execute smart and innovative experimental strategies that generate interpretable data, test hypotheses, answer key scientific questions, and move projects forward.
• · Implement cutting-edge technologies for target identification, validation, and structure/function studies and eventually drive drug discovery programs from inception through all stages
• · Partner closely across Oncology expertise groups and with teams across the global Novartis organization.
• · Communicate scientific concepts and project progress clearly, objectively, and data-driven across different settings and audiences.
• · Manage laboratory resources flexibly and effectively as priorities evolve. Minimum requirements:
• · Ph.D. in cancer biology, molecular biology biochemistry or a related field, with limited (up to 5 years) postdoctoral experience preferred.
• · Evidenced productivity and proven ability to deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced, productive, and competitive scientific environment.
• · Experience in drug discovery and project leadership in biotech or pharmaceutical settings is a plus.
• · Experience with microscopy and imaging technologies is a plus.
• · Excellent communication and presentation skills across a broad range of topics and adapted to variety of audiences.
• · Proven ability to coach, mentor, and develop team members.
• · Fluency in English, oral and written. Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion: We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve. Benefits & Rewards At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Job Description Summary Location: Basel, Switzerland #onsite Role Purpose: We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Expert Analytical Scientist with extensive experience in mass spectrometry to join our Analytical Research & Development (ARD) team. ARD is part of the Technical R&D Department within Development and plays a pivotal role in the characterization and analysis of Drug Substances and Drug Products throughout the transition from discovery to commercial production. Job Description Responsibilities include designing, executing, and planning scientific experiments, and reporting results in line with the ARD Oligonucleotides Analytics project. Ensure timely, high-quality delivery of supplies and knowledge generation. Lead, manage, and support project and team activities, contribute to analytical strategy, and promote scientific and operational excellence within the TRD-NCE goals. This role is part of the ARD Science & Operation - Oligonucleotides Analytics Team. Major accountabilities:
• Independently design, plan, execute, interpret, and report analytical activities for Oligonucleotides (DS and DP) utilizing cutting-edge analytical sciences and technologies (such as analytical method development, validation, transfer, stability, release testing, and formulation development analytics) in accordance with established timelines and quality standards. This position also requires active participation in laboratory operations.
• Develop and apply mass spectrometry methods for oligonucleotides.
• Foster and share best practices, provide robust scientific and technical expertise within the analytical project sub-team, among analytical scientists, and throughout the organization.
• Create analytical documents that align with global project strategies by phase. Assist in strategic planning, design, and execution.
• Participate to the planning and implementation of laboratory experiments for designated projects, including activity scheduling, experiment monitoring, and data analysis.
• Main contact for science and technical issues with internal stakeholders.
• Offer scientific guidance and mentorship to laboratory associates.
• Oversee technical analytical deviations and recommend appropriate corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs).
• Assist with audits and health authority inspections, making sure there are no major findings in the areas assigned.
• Follow SOPs, GMP, GLP, QM, HSE, ISRM, and Novartis Guidelines.
• Demonstrate excellent collaboration and encourage sharing of expertise. Minimum Requirements:
• PhD with a minimum of 3 years’s experience or Master degree in analytical chemistry with a minimum of 10 years’ experience in the pharmaceutical industry.
• Proficiency in using hyphenated analytical separation and detection techniques including mass spectrometry.
• Excellent knowledge of general laboratory management and analytical techniques. , e.g. HPLC, UV-spectrometry, titration.
• Proven experience in quality principles driving drug development such as GMP; understanding of general regulatory and quality expectations.
• Ability to perform in a highly dynamic environment
• Key qualities include strong coordination, clear communication, teamwork, self-motivation, and quick learning. Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams' representative of the patients and communities we serve. Accessibility and accommodation Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to all individuals. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, or in order to receive more detailed information about the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mail to inclusion.switzerland@novartis.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please include the job requisition number in your mes

• Costruire, guidare e sviluppare un team di ingegneri AI interni ed esterni altamente performanti impostando priorità chiare, coltivando competenze, e garantendo un'eccellenza costante nella costruzione, scalare, rilasciare e sostenere soluzioni AI, tra cui qualità a lungo termine e proprietà operativa.

• Esperienza con le pratiche di distribuzione, monitoraggio, automazione e ciclo di vita per le soluzioni AI, tra cui ottimizzazione delle prestazioni, gestione dei costi e disponibilità operativa, nonché governance e conformità. Gamma di insalata: CHF150,500.00 - CHF279,500.00 Descrizione del lavoro #LI-Hybrid # Ubicazione: Basilea, Svizzera Stiamo attualmente cercando 2 associati per aderire al nostro team. Il team International Medical Affairs (IMA) rappresenta la voce dei mercati internazionali, con un focus sui nostri mercati prioritari e affronta le loro esigenze in pre-lancio, lancio, gestione del ciclo di vita e mercato. Stiamo cercando un direttore medico Neuroscience, per fornire input allineati dai principali mercati internazionali in IEP ed è responsabile per l'attuazione della strategia di comunicazione scientifica e di educazione medica, così come gli standard medici rilevanti in questi mercati. Questo ruolo sosterrà la pianificazione e l'esecuzione a International per la strategia di fidanzamento medico/scientifico (strategia MSL/ Field Medical Affairs, programmi di educazione medica, pianificazione della pubblicazione scientifica e sviluppo della rete di esperti medici) affrontando e fornendo pre-lancio strategico e avviando le attività mediche esigenze di paziente, clinica, accesso e valore ai sistemi sanitari. In qualità di esperto in materia nello sviluppo delle strategie di overarching per International, il Direttore IMA fornirà input durante la progettazione e lungo l'esecuzione end-to-end dei programmi. Agisce come partner strategico per il commercio internazionale, il valore internazionale e l'accesso, globale, regionale e US MA, e lo sviluppo. Il ruolo riporta nel direttore esecutivo, Affari medici internazionali. Descrizione del lavoro Responsabilità chiave:
• Esegui la strategia di lancio di affari medici per i programmi di neuroscienze nei principali paesi internazionali, tra cui tattiche di trasformazione come partnership innovative.
• Partner con le organizzazioni di Medical Affairs nei principali paesi e regioni internazionali per garantire una forte concentrazione di consegna sulle esigenze del paese.
• Consulente ai piani per la generazione di prove, strategia MSL / Field Medical Affairs, programmi di educazione medica, pianificazione della pubblicazione scientifica e sviluppo di rete di esperti medici con TA.
• Fornire input per e modellare lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di piani di istruzione innovativa e comunicazione scientifica per gli stakeholder esterni a International.
• Monitoraggio finanziario per garantire lo sviluppo tempestivo e conveniente e l'esecuzione delle attività mediche.
• Rappresentano gli Affari medici internazionali intorno al portafoglio prioritario con gli Affari interni (Global Medical Affairs, Development, Biomedical Research ecc.) e il pubblico esterno, in collaborazione con International Commercial, tra cui gli investimenti, le comunità mediche e regolamentari, così come i collaboratori/partner dell'industria farmaceutica o biotecnologica.
• Fornire la direzione e l'ingresso nello sviluppo e l'attuazione di rimborsi di successo e strategie di accesso al mercato.
• Fornire input per modellare le strategie mediche di campo, sviluppa ed esegue i piani medici di campo, garantire l'implementazione di iniziative mediche di campo chiave, ad esempio, la raccolta di informazioni, la condivisione e la traduzione in azione, lo sviluppo e lo svolgimento di formazioni su area di malattia e conoscenze mediche / scientifiche e guida lo spiegamento di MSL.
• Fornire un contributo medico proattivo alla gestione del ciclo di vita degli asset per considerare nuove opportunità terapeutiche. Assicurarsi che i programmi di accesso al paziente sono supportati all'interno di International Medical Affairs e consegnati con piena conformità.
• Assicura che le attività di International Medical Affairs siano progettate ed eseguite in conformità con le linee guida della politica aziendale e i più elevati standard di qualità medica. Requisiti essenziali:
• Laurea scientifica avanzata (MD, PhD, o PharmD) in Scienze della salute o della vita.
• 8+ anni di esperienza negli affari medici dell'industria farmaceutica.
• Importanti affari medici pre-lancio e lancio esperienza in un grande mercato internazionale.
• Esperienza di lavoro nelle organizzazioni di matrice e dei principali progetti medici interfunzionali, con la capacità di influenzare e collaborare tra funzioni e geografie.
• Traccia forte

L'équipe des Affaires Médicales Internationales (IMA) représente la voix des marchés internationaux, en mettant l'accent sur nos marchés prioritaires et en répondant à leurs besoins à travers le pré-lancement, le lancement, la gestion du cycle de vie et sur le marché. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un directeur des Affaires médicales Neurosciences, pour fournir une contribution harmonisée des marchés internationaux les plus prioritaires à l'IEP et est responsable de la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de communication scientifique et d'éducation médicale, ainsi que des normes médicales pertinentes dans ces marchés. Ce rôle appuiera la planification et l'exécution à International de la stratégie d'engagement médical/scientifique (stratégie sur les affaires médicales sur le terrain, programmes d'éducation médicale, planification de publications scientifiques et développement de réseaux d'experts médicaux) visant à répondre aux besoins stratégiques de pré-lancement et de lancement d'activités médicales pour les patients, les cliniques, l'accès et la valeur des systèmes de soins de santé. En sa qualité d'expert en la matière dans l'élaboration des stratégies globales pour International, le directeur de l'IAM fournira des contributions pendant la conception et pendant l'exécution de bout en bout des programmes. Agir en tant que partenaire stratégique pour le commerce international, la valeur et l'accès internationaux, l'AM mondiale, régionale et américaine, et le développement. Ce rôle relève du Directeur exécutif, Affaires médicales internationales. Description de l'emploi Principales responsabilités :
• Exécuter des affaires médicales lancer une stratégie pour les programmes de neurosciences dans des pays internationaux clés, y compris des tactiques de transformation comme des partenariats novateurs.
• Établir des partenariats avec des organisations des affaires médicales dans les principaux pays et régions du monde pour veiller à ce que les activités soient axées sur les besoins des pays.
• Avis aux plans de production de données probantes, stratégie MSL/Affaires médicales sur le terrain, programmes de formation médicale, planification des publications scientifiques et développement de réseaux d'experts médicaux avec les AT.
• Contribuer à l'élaboration et à la mise en oeuvre de plans novateurs d'éducation et de communication scientifique à l'intention des parties prenantes externes à l'International et les façonner.
• Suivi financier pour assurer le développement et l'exécution rapides et rentables des activités médicales.
• Représenter les affaires médicales internationales autour d'un portefeuille prioritaire avec des auditoires internes (Affaires médicales mondiales, Développement, Recherche biomédicale, etc.) et externes, en collaboration avec le secteur commercial international, y compris les milieux de l'investissement, de la médecine et de la réglementation, ainsi que des collaborateurs/partenaires de l'industrie pharmaceutique ou de la biotechnologie.
• Fournir une orientation et une contribution à l'élaboration et à la mise en oeuvre de stratégies efficaces de remboursement et d'accès au marché.
• Fournir des commentaires pour façonner les stratégies médicales sur le terrain, élaborer et exécuter les plans médicaux sur le terrain, assurer la mise en oeuvre d'initiatives médicales sur le terrain clés, p. ex. collecte de renseignements, partage et application en action, élaboration et réalisation de formations sur le domaine des maladies et les connaissances médicales et scientifiques, et guider le déploiement des LSM.
• Fournir une contribution médicale proactive à la gestion du cycle de vie des biens pour envisager de nouvelles possibilités thérapeutiques. Veiller à ce que les programmes d'accès des patients soient appuyés dans le cadre des Affaires médicales internationales et qu'ils soient entièrement respectés.
• S'assure que les activités des Affaires médicales internationales sont conçues et exécutées conformément aux lignes directrices de l'entreprise et aux normes de qualité médicale les plus élevées. Exigences essentielles :
• Diplôme scientifique avancé (MD, doctorat ou PharmD) en santé ou en sciences de la vie.
• 8 ans et plus d'expérience en affaires médicales de l'industrie pharmaceutique.
• Des affaires médicales importantes pré-lancent et lancent l'expérience sur un grand marché international.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Salary Range: CHF129,500.00 - CHF240,500.00 Job Description Summary #LI-Hybrid Location: Basel, Switzerland Internal title: Associate Director, Search & Evaluation Join us at the forefront of scientific innovation, where your insights can shape the future of Immunology at Novartis. In this role, you will identify and evaluate novel therapeutics with the potential to transform the practice of medicine for patients suffering from immunological diseases. The scope includes a wide range of tasks from contributing to the partnering strategy, accessing targets and novel biology of therapeutic relevance across all development stages. The individual acts as an ambassador for the Immunology Therapeutic Area and for the broader organization and serves as a go to person for respective external partnering opportunities. Working across research, commercial, and business development teams, you will play a pivotal role in uncovering high-impact opportunities, building strategic partnerships, and driving growth through informed decision-making. If you are passionate about translating scientific innovation into real-world impact and thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment, this is your opportunity to make a difference. Job Description Key Responsibilities
• Identify and evaluate external therapeutic opportunities aligned with Immunology strategy across the development value chain
• Lead search activities and efficient triaging and prioritization leveraging in depth knowledge in the immunology therapeutic area, and ensure prioritization aligns with strategic business development and licensing objectives.
• Build and analyze competitive landscapes and innovation ecosystems to inform opportunity sourcing and decision-making
• Conduct triage and due diligence for inbound opportunities with clear documentation and structured recommendations
• Collaborate cross-functionally to prepare high-quality materials for governance reviews and deal execution processes
• Engage stakeholders across research, commercial, and corporate development to drive alignment and informed decisions
• Present strategic opportunities to senior leadership and contribute to internal consensus building
• Represent Novartis at industry conferences and external meetings to strengthen partnerships and market visibility Essential Requirements
• Advanced university degree in life sciences
• Working experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, preferably in business development, strategy, consulting, or research, either in-house in a biotech or pharmaceutical company or working with health care clients
• Strong understanding of drug discovery, clinical development, and emerging therapeutic concepts
• Demonstrated ability to analyze complex scientific data and translate insights into strategic recommendations

Gamma di insalata: 102.200,00 CHF - 189.800,00 CHF Descrizione del lavoro Ubicazione: Rotkreuz, Svizzera #LI-Hybrid Scopo del ruolo: Il Business Partner Integrato Insights è un ruolo di livello nazionale all'interno del pilastro Integrato Insights e DAP (Data Analytics & Platforms) di Execution Excellence presso Novartis Pharma Svizzera. Il ruolo esiste per fare una cosa eccezionalmente bene: trasformare i dati in insights che spostano l'ago per Area Terapeutica assegnata (s) e Valore & Access (V&A). Questo è un ruolo strategico di comprensione con una forte profondità analitica applicata. I partner commerciali integrati di Insights vanno oltre a segnalare ciò che è successo, spiegano perché è successo, cosa significa, e che cosa l'organizzazione dovrebbe fare su di esso. Traducono la complessità del mercato svizzero, l'attività commerciale locale e le tendenze globali in raccomandazioni chiare e attuabili che influenzano il marchio e le decisioni di accesso a livello di leadership TA Head e senior. Descrizione del lavoro Principali passività 1. TA / V&A Strategic Insight Partnership
• Agire come punto di contatto primario integrato per TA(s) e/o V&A assegnati, collaborando direttamente con TA Heads, Sales Heads, team di marca e V&A come consulente analitico di fiducia.
• Traduci TA, brand e le strategie di accesso in un chiaro programma di informazioni, definendo le domande aziendali che contano di più e modellando un piano di ricerca e analisi basato su ipotesi per rispondere a loro.
• Spostare la funzione oltre la reportistica reattiva verso una generazione di insight proattiva, basata su ipotesi e previsionale, portando segnali di mercato emergenti, cambiamenti di comportamento del cliente e movimenti competitivi al tavolo prima che il business chieda.
• Consolidare le esigenze di comprensione tra le parti interessate di TA, Commercial, V&A e Medical Affairs (nell'ambito di un'adeguata separazione medica/commerciale), assicurando un'agenda di comprensione unificata e prioritaria per l'ambito assegnato.
• Sfidare i leader di business senior costruttivamente, porre le domande giuste al momento giusto, e portare onestà intellettuale all'interpretazione dei risultati, compresi i risultati scomodi. 2. Performance Insights & Dashboard Stewardship
• Possedere la narrazione analitica attraverso dashboard di performance per TA(s)/V&A assegnati, coprendo i KPI commerciali (sale, quota di mercato, esecuzione del campo), metriche di engagement sul campo (attività di rep, impegno omnichannel, portata del cliente), V&A KPIs (misure di accesso, metriche di payer) e supporto di analisi per gli Affari medici (impegno sul campo medico e altre analisi), con una corretta separazione tra le opinioni commerciali e mediche mantenute in tutto.
• Definire ed evolvere KPI, metriche di performance e Indicatori di successo commerciale (CSI) in collaborazione con TA, Sales Manager, V&A e DAP Manager, assicurando che i cruscotti rimangano decisivi in quanto il business si evolve.
• Costruisci viste analitiche ad-hoc, approfondisci e bespoke PowerBI dashboard direttamente quando le domande aziendali lo richiedono; partner con il DAP Manager quando il lavoro richiede la modellazione dei dati aziendali, l'infrastruttura di produzione o la scala oltre un'analisi single-purpose.
• Convalida integrità analitica e accuratezza delle dashboard aziendali da una prospettiva aziendale, semplificare e migliorare continuamente per l'adozione degli stakeholder.
• Utilizzare cruscotti come uno strumento di storytelling primario, interpretare le tendenze, evidenziare le implicazioni "così che" e trasformare i numeri in chiare narrazioni per le recensioni di affari TA, recensioni di brand plan e forum di leadership senior.
• Assicurare l'integrazione dei KPI interni con fonti di dati esterne (ad esempio, pannelli IQVIA, OFAC, dati grossisti, dati del mercato secondario, intelligenza competitiva) in opinioni olistiche sulle prestazioni del mercato, del cliente e del marchio.
• Agire come unico punto di contatto locale all'interno di TA per dati e approfondimenti secondari (ad esempio, IQVIA, OFAC). 3. Previsione, Lifecycle & Field-to-Sales Analytics
• Preparare e mantenere presupposti e definizioni di mercato TA/V&A utilizzate nella previsione (epidemiologia, assunzione, eventi concorrenti, pietre miliari di accesso),

Salary Range: 102.200,00 CHF - 189.800,00 CHF Job Description Summary Location: Rotkreuz, Switzerland #LI-Hybrid Purpose of the role: The Integrated Insights Business Partner is a country-level role within the Integrated Insights and DAP (Data Analytics & Platforms) pillar of Execution Excellence at Novartis Pharma Switzerland. The role exists to do one thing exceptionally well: turn data into insights that move the needle for assigned Therapeutic Area(s) and Value & Access (V&A). This is a strategic insight role with strong applied analytical depth. The Integrated Insights Business Partners go beyond reporting what happened, they explain why it happened, what it means, and what the organization should do about it. They translate the complexity of the Swiss market, local commercial activity and global trends into clear, actionable recommendations that influence brand and access decisions at the TA Head and senior leadership level. Job Description Major Accountabilities 1. TA / V&A Strategic Insight Partnership
• Act as the primary Integrated Insights point of contact for assigned TA(s) and/or V&A, partnering directly with TA Heads, Sales Heads, brand teams, and V&A leads as a trusted analytical advisor.
• Translate TA, brand and access strategies into a clear insight agenda, defining the business questions that matter most and shaping a hypothesis-driven research and analytics plan to answer them.
• Move the function beyond reactive reporting toward proactive, hypothesis-driven and forward-looking insight generation, bringing emerging market signals, customer behavior shifts and competitive moves to the table before the business asks.
• Consolidate insight needs across TA, Commercial, V&A and Medical Affairs stakeholders (within appropriate medical/commercial separation), ensuring a unified, prioritized insight agenda for the assigned scope.
• Challenge senior business leaders constructively, ask the right questions at the right time, and bring intellectual honesty to interpretation of results, including uncomfortable findings. 2. Performance Insights & Dashboard Stewardship
• Own the analytical narrative across performance dashboards for assigned TA(s)/V&A, covering Commercial KPIs (sales, market share, field execution), field engagement metrics (rep activity, omnichannel engagement, customer reach), V&A KPIs (access milestones, payer metrics) and analytics support for Medical Affairs (medical field engagement and other analytics), with appropriate separation between commercial and medical views maintained throughout.
• Define and evolve KPIs, performance metrics and Commercial Success Indicators (CSIs) in partnership with TAs, Sales Managers, V&A and the DAP Manager, ensuring dashboards remain decision-relevant as the business evolves.
• Build ad-hoc analytical views, deep-dives and bespoke PowerBI dashboards directly when business questions demand it; partner with the DAP Manager when the work requires enterprise data modelling, production-grade infrastructure or scale beyond a single-purpose analysis.
• Validate analytical integrity and accuracy of enterprise dashboards from a business perspective, continuously simplify and improve them for stakeholder adoption.
• Use dashboards as a primary storytelling tool, interpreting trends, highlighting "so what" implications, and turning numbers into clear narratives for TA business reviews, brand plan reviews and senior leadership forums.
• Ensure integration of internal KPIs with external data sources (e.g., IQVIA panels, OFAC, wholesaler data, secondary market data, competitive intelligence) into holistic views of market, customer and brand performance.
• Act as the local single point of contact within TA for secondary data and insights (e.g., IQVIA, OFAC). 3. Forecasting, Lifecycle & Field-to-Sales Analytics
• Prepare and maintain TA/V&A market assumptions and definitions used in forecasting (epidemiology, uptake, competitor events, access milestones),

• Assurer l'intégration des ICR internes avec les sources de données externes (p. ex. panneaux IQVIA, OFAC, données sur les grossistes, données sur les marchés secondaires, intelligence concurrentielle) dans des visions globales des performances du marché, des clients et des marques.
• Agir comme point de contact unique local au sein de l'AT pour les données et les idées secondaires (p. ex. IQVIA, OFAC). 3. Prévision, cycle de vie et analyse champ-à-vente
• Préparer et maintenir les hypothèses et les définitions du marché de l'AT/V&A utilisées dans la prévision (épidémiologie, absorption, événements concurrents, jalons d'accès);

titleByLocale.fr: Directeur, Strategic Projects Lead

descriptionByLocale.it:
Salary Range: CHF142,100.00 - CHF263,900.00 Job Description Summary Location: Basel, Switzerland The Executive Director, Strategic Projects Lead is a cross-disciplinary thinker with an, entrepreneurial mindset, and an uncompromising drive to transform drug development and improve patient lives. Defined by highly proficient program management expertise, this role is a proven project leader who can drive high-performing cross-functional teams (Development Units and Functions), and engage with Senior Leadership, challenge the status quo through novel thinking and deliver measurable organizational impact. Job Description This role is accountable for delivering Strategic Imperatives for the Development Unit by taking ownership for the creation, planning and independent operationalization of specific strategic projects in landscape mode. The role is expected to enhance the executional certainty of assigned initiatives by deploying best-in-class project management practices, successfully leading multi-disciplinary teams (influencing through the matrix) and integrating insights from internal and external specialists. Major accountabilities:
• Identify, propose, and deliver strategic and operational imperatives for Development as x-functional strategic projects using data as the performance baseline.
• Accountable for the faultless, independent delivery of large-scale strategic projects that employ project management best practices to enhance certainty of success (i.e., project plans – scope, time, cost/resources, communication plans, impact measures/ metrics).
• Structure ambiguous problems and take action to solve them, with clear linkage to Development objectives, strategy and priorities.
• Synthesize clear takeaways from complex information into outcomes and recommendations using both qualitative and quantitative methods (i.e., external benchmarks, internal metrics, process performance analyses etc.).
• Lead cross-functional teams, influencing without authority, to develop the best solution and move stakeholders and the organization to act
• Establish trust-based relationships with leaders and stakeholders to better serve their organizations.
• Deploy excellent verbal and written communication skills to transmit information effectively to all audiences, including senior leaders, in a structured manner.
• Drive project teams and organizations to comprehensively improve operating model design, process simplification, data & technology enablement, and financial success, whilst ensuring quality standards and regulatory compliance.
• Role model exceptional company values and behaviours, embracing high-challenge conversations, to drive change (ethics, change agent, collaboration, humility).
• Maintain awareness of process improvement methodologies and best practices (e.g., IQP, lean six sigma, Scrum, Agile, etc. ) Minimum Requirements
• Ideally 3rd level degree educated in a relevant discipline in Life Sciences or Life Science Engineering. Further qualifications such as MBA would be an advantage.
• Minimum experience of 10-12 years in Research & Development strategic consulting and/or Line Function in Development
• Corporate/development experience in complex project management
• Must have experience in Drug Discovery and Drug Development In-depth experience of the drug discovery lifecycle and R&D functions
• Proven trach-record managing complex, cross-functional Projects with senior stakeholder engagement Accessibility and accommodation Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to all individuals. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, or in order to receive more detailed information about the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mail to diversity.inclusion_ch@novartis.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please include the job requisitio

titleByLocale.fr: Directeur, AI Activement, Affaires générales

descriptionByLocale.it:
Gamma di insalata: CHF146,300.00 - CHF271,700.00 Descrizione del lavoro Siamo un team di persone dedicate e appassionate unite da una spinta a raggiungere insieme. Questo è un ruolo di leadership senior responsabile per la definizione e la fornitura della strategia AI che trasforma come Novartis Corporate Affairs crea e offre valore aziendale. Si imposta la visione pluriennale per l'attivazione AI attraverso la funzione, condurre un team all'esecuzione, condurre lo sviluppo del portafoglio, e rappresentare Affari aziendali come la nostra voce principale su AI nei forum aziendali senior. Avrete il pieno ciclo di vita dell'IA in affari aziendali, dai casi di strategia e di business attraverso la consegna, la governance, l'adozione e il valore realizzato, ed è misurato dall'impatto strategico, operativo e reputazionale AI genera per la funzione e l'impresa. Descrizione del lavoro #LI-Hybrid # Ubicazione: Basilea, Svizzera Principali responsabilità
• Progettare e implementare una strategia AI pluriennale definita ed esecutiva per gli Affari Aziendali che anticipa come l'IA ridividerà le comunicazioni, gli affari pubblici, ESG e l'impegno degli stakeholder.
• Guidare la strategia e lo sviluppo di un portafoglio AI prioritario governato come investimento gestito, con trade-off disciplinati attraverso l'impatto strategico e operativo, la disponibilità dei dati e la velocità al valore.
• Guidare la strategia e l'esecuzione per i casi di business approvati e le decisioni di finanziamento per ogni iniziativa nel portafoglio, con obiettivi di valore quantificati, metodologia ROI e chiara logica di reinvestimento legata ai risultati aziendali.
• Noleggiare e sviluppare un team AI altamente performante con la profondità tecnica e il giudizio necessario per fornire soluzioni AI di livello enterprise.
• Fornire valore aziendale realizzato attraverso soluzioni implementate — misurate nel tempo recuperate, produttività acquisita, opportunità catturate, intuizioni accelerate, o capacità strategica creata — tracciato contro casi di business approvati.
• Rappresentano gli Affari Aziendali negli organi di governance AI aziendali, consigli tecnologici e forum interfunzionali senior.
• Servire come consulente senior di fiducia con il Chief Corporate Affairs Officer, capo di stato maggiore e altri dirigenti sulla strategia, opportunità e altro ancora.
• Possiede il quadro di governance AI per gli Affari Aziendali, congiuntamente definito con IT, Legale e Compliance con zero conformità dei materiali, privacy, o incidenti responsabile-AI in tutto il portafoglio. Criteri essenziali
• Laurea in Informatica, Scienza dei dati, Ingegneria, o un campo tecnico correlato richiesto. Grado avanzato (MS, MBA, o equivalente) preferito.
• Ampia esperienza progressiva nell'intelligenza artificiale, nella trasformazione digitale e nella strategia tecnologica, con una comprovata traccia di definizione e di leadership della strategia AI per una funzione o un'unità aziendale principali — compresa la proprietà di investimenti, portafoglio e realizzazione del valore.
• Forte track record di fornire AI di livello di produzione, AI generativo, o soluzioni di analisi avanzate in un ambiente complesso, con la proprietà dimostrabile dei risultati aziendali.
• La fluidità tecnica a mano con grandi modelli di lingua, applicazioni AI generative e agentic, e i principi di ingegneria dei dati e di machine learning che sostengono l'IA di livello enterprise, tra cui AI responsabile e rischio di modello.
• Prove esperienze di costruzione e team leader di AI, dati o professionisti della tecnologia, tra cui collaboratori individuali senior.
• Capacità di operare credibilmente a livello dirigenziale senior — consulenza e briefing leader C-suite sulla strategia, il rischio e il valore dell'intelligenza artificiale — con esperienza sostanziale che conduce le partnership interfunzionali attraverso funzioni IT, Legale, Compliance, Procurement e business.
• Esperienza diretta con o lavorando all'interno delle funzioni Corporate Affairs, Communications, Public Affairs, Policy o Reputation Management, con una comprensione sofisticata di come queste funzioni creano e proteggono il valore aziendale. Criteri discreti:
• Farmaceutici, sanitari o altro settore globale altamente regolamentato
descriptionByLocale.en:
Salary Range: CHF146,300.00 - CHF271,700.00 Job Description Summary We’re a team of dedicated and passionate people united by a drive to achieve together. This is a senior leadership role accountable for defining and delivering the AI strategy that transforms how Novartis Corporate Affairs creates and delivers enterprise value. You will set the multi-year vision for AI enablement across the function, lead a team to execution, lead the development of the portfolio, and represent Corporate Affairs as our lead voice on AI in senior enterprise forums. You will own the full lifecycle of AI in Corporate Affairs, from strategy and business cases through delivery, governance, adoption, and realized value, and is measured by the strategic, operational, and reputational impact AI generates for the function and the enterprise. Job Description #LI-Hybrid Location: Basel, Switzerland Key Responsibilities
• Design and implement a defined and executive-endorsed multi-year AI strategy for Corporate Affairs that anticipates how AI will reshape communications, public affairs, ESG, and stakeholder engagement.
• Lead the strategy and development of a prioritized AI portfolio governed as a managed investment, with disciplined trade-offs across strategic and operational impact, data readiness, and speed to value.
• Lead the strategy and execution for approved business cases and funding decisions for every initiative in the portfolio, with quantified value targets, ROI methodology, and clear reinvestment logic linked to enterprise outcomes.
• Hire and develop a high-performing AI team with the technical depth and judgment required to deliver enterprise-grade AI solutions.
• Deliver realized business value across deployed solutions — measured in time recovered, productivity gained, opportunities captured, insights accelerated, or strategic capacity created — tracked against approved business cases.
• Represent Corporate Affairs in enterprise AI governance bodies, technology councils, and senior cross-functional forums.
• Serve as a trusted senior advisor with the Chief Corporate Affairs Officer, Chief of Staff, and other executive leaders on AI strategy, opportunity, and more.
• Own the AI governance framework for Corporate Affairs, jointly defined with IT, Legal, and Compliance with zero material compliance, privacy, or responsible-AI incidents across the portfolio. Essential Criteria
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related technical field required. Advanced degree (MS, MBA, or equivalent) preferred.
• Extensive progressive experience in AI, digital transformation, and technology strategy, with a proven track record of defining and leading AI strategy for a major function or business unit — including ownership of investment, portfolio, and value realization.
• Strong track record of delivering production-grade AI, generative AI, or advanced analytics solutions in a complex environment, with demonstrable ownership of business outcomes.
• Hands-on technical fluency with large language models, generative and agentic AI applications, and the data engineering and machine learning operations principles that underpin enterprise-grade AI, including responsible AI and model risk.
• Proven experience building and leading teams of AI, data, or technology professionals, including senior individual contributors.
• Ability to operate credibly at senior executive level — advising and briefing C-suite leaders on AI strategy, risk, and value — with substantive experience leading cross-functional partnerships across IT, Legal, Compliance, Procurement, and business functions.
• Direct experience partnering with or working inside Corporate Affairs, Communications, Public Affairs, Policy, or Reputation Management functions, with a sophisticated understanding of how these functions create and protect enterprise value. Desirable Criteria:
• Pharmaceuticals, healthcare, or other highly regulated global industry
descriptionByLocale.de:
Gehaltsbereich: CHF146.300.00 - CHF271.700.00 Stellenbeschreibung Zusammenfassung Wir sind ein Team von engagierten und leidenschaftlichen Menschen, vereint durch den Antrieb, gemeinsam etwas zu erreichen. Dies ist eine Führungsrolle, die für die Definition und Umsetzung der KI-Strategie verantwortlich ist, die die Art und Weise verändert, wie Novartis Corporate Affairs Unternehmenswerte schafft und liefert. Sie werden die mehrjährige Vision für KI-Enablement in der gesamten Funktion festlegen, ein Team zur Ausführung führen, die Entwicklung des Portfolios leiten und Corporate Affairs als unsere führende Stimme für KI in Senioren-Unternehmensforen vertreten. Sie besitzen den gesamten Lebenszyklus von KI in Corporate Affairs, von Strategie- und Geschäftsfällen über Lieferung, Governance, Adoption und realisierten Wert, und werden an den strategischen, operativen und Reputationsauswirkungen gemessen, die KI für die Funktion und das Unternehmen generiert. Stellenbeschreibung #LI-Hybrid Standort: Basel, Schweiz Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten
• Konzipieren und implementieren Sie eine definierte und von Führungskräften unterstützte mehrjährige KI-Strategie für Corporate Affairs, die antizipiert, wie KI Kommunikation, öffentliche Angelegenheiten, ESG und Stakeholder-Engagement umgestalten wird.
• Führen Sie die Strategie und Entwicklung eines priorisierten KI-Portfolios, das als verwaltete Investition mit disziplinierten Kompromissen in Bezug auf strategische und operative Auswirkungen, Datenbereitschaft und Wertsteigerung geregelt wird.
• Führen Sie die Strategie und Durchführung für genehmigte Geschäftsfälle und Finanzierungsentscheidungen für jede Initiative im Portfolio mit quantifizierten Wertzielen, ROI-Methodik und klarer Reinvestitionslogik in Verbindung mit Unternehmensergebnissen.
• Stellen und entwickeln Sie ein leistungsstarkes KI-Team mit der technischen Tiefe und dem erforderlichen Urteilsvermögen, um KI-Lösungen für Unternehmen zu liefern.
• Erzielen Sie einen realisierten Geschäftswert für alle bereitgestellten Lösungen - gemessen an der gewonnenen Zeit, der erzielten Produktivität, den erfassten Chancen, den beschleunigten Erkenntnissen oder der Schaffung strategischer Kapazitäten - und anhand genehmigter Geschäftsfälle.
• Repräsentieren Sie Corporate Affairs in Unternehmens-KI-Governance-Gremien, Technologieräten und leitenden cross-funktionalen Foren.
• Dienen Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Senior Advisor beim Chief Corporate Affairs Officer, Chief of Staff und anderen Führungskräften in Bezug auf KI-Strategie, Chancen und mehr.
• Besitzen Sie das AI-Governance-Framework für Corporate Affairs, das gemeinsam mit IT, Legal und Compliance mit Null-Material-Compliance, Datenschutz oder verantwortlichen AI-Vorfällen im gesamten Portfolio definiert wird. Wesentliche Kriterien
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, Data Science, Engineering oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich erforderlich. Fortgeschrittener Abschluss (MS, MBA oder gleichwertig) bevorzugt.
• Umfangreiche fortschrittliche Erfahrung in den Bereichen KI, digitale Transformation und Technologiestrategie mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz bei der Definition und Führung der KI-Strategie für eine wichtige Funktion oder Geschäftseinheit - einschließlich Besitz von Investitionen, Portfolio und Wertrealisierung.
• Starke Erfolgsbilanz bei der Bereitstellung von produktionsorientierter KI, generativer KI oder fortschrittlichen Analyselösungen in einer komplexen Umgebung mit nachweislicher Eigenverantwortung für Geschäftsergebnisse.
• Hands-on technische Fließfähigkeit mit großen Sprachmodellen, generativen und agentischen KI-Anwendungen und den Prinzipien des Data Engineering und des maschinellen Lernens, die die Unternehmens-KI unterstützen, einschließlich verantwortungsvoller KI und Modellrisiken.
• Bewährte Erfahrung beim Aufbau und der Leitung von Teams von KI-, Daten- oder Technologieexperten, einschließlich leitender Mitarbeiter.
• Fähigkeit, auf leitender Führungsebene glaubwürdig zu arbeiten - Beratung und Briefing von Führungskräften der C-Suite zu KI-Strategie, Risiko und Wert - mit fundierter Erfahrung bei der Leitung funktionsübergreifender Partnerschaften in den Bereichen IT, Legal, Compliance, Beschaffung und Geschäftsfunktionen.
• Direkte Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit oder der Arbeit in Corporate Affairs, Communications, Public Affairs, Policy oder Reputation Management-Funktionen mit einem ausgeklügelten Verständnis dafür, wie diese Funktionen Unternehmenswert schaffen und schützen. Erwünschte Kriterien:
• Pharmazeutika, Gesundheitswesen oder andere stark regulierte globale Industrie
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Échelle salariale : 146300,00 CHF - 271 700,00 CHF Résumé de la description d'emploi Nous sommes une équipe de gens dévoués et passionnés unis par une volonté de réaliser ensemble. Il s'agit d'un rôle de leadership supérieur responsable de la définition et de la mise en oeuvre de la stratégie d'IA qui transforme la façon dont Novartis Corporate Affairs crée et fournit la valeur de l'entreprise. Vous définirez la vision pluriannuelle de l'activation de l'IA dans l'ensemble de la fonction, dirigerez une équipe à l'exécution, dirigerez le développement du portefeuille et représenterez les Affaires corporatives comme notre voix principale sur l'IA dans les forums d'entreprises seniors. Vous posséderez le cycle de vie complet de l'IA en affaires d'entreprise, de la stratégie et des analyses de rentabilisation à la prestation, la gouvernance, l'adoption et la valeur réalisée, et est mesuré par l'impact stratégique, opérationnel et de réputation que l'IA génère pour la fonction et l'entreprise. Description de l'emploi #LI-Hybrid Lieu: Bâle, Suisse Principales responsabilités
• Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre une stratégie pluriannuelle d'IA pour les affaires ministérielles, définie et approuvée par la direction, qui prévoit comment l'IA remodelera les communications, les affaires publiques, l'ESG et la participation des intervenants.
• Diriger la stratégie et l'élaboration d'un portefeuille d'intelligence artificielle prioritaire régi comme un investissement géré, avec des compromis disciplinés sur l'impact stratégique et opérationnel, l'état de préparation des données et la rapidité de mise en valeur.
• Diriger la stratégie et l'exécution des analyses de rentabilisation et des décisions de financement approuvées pour chaque initiative du portefeuille, avec des objectifs quantifiés de valeur, une méthodologie de ROI et une logique claire de réinvestissement liée aux résultats de l'entreprise.
• Embaucher et développer une équipe d'IA hautement performante avec la profondeur technique et le jugement requis pour fournir des solutions d'IA de qualité entreprise.
• Fournir la valeur opérationnelle réalisée pour les solutions déployées — mesurée en temps récupéré, productivité gagnée, possibilités saisies, perspectives accélérées ou capacité stratégique créée — en fonction des analyses de rentabilisation approuvées.
• Représenter les Affaires corporatives dans les organes de gouvernance de l'IA d'entreprise, les conseils technologiques et les forums interfonctionnels de haut niveau.
• Servir de conseiller principal de confiance auprès du dirigeant principal des affaires ministérielles, du chef de cabinet et d'autres dirigeants exécutifs sur la stratégie, les possibilités et plus encore en matière d'IA.
• Posséder le cadre de gouvernance de l'IA pour les affaires ministérielles, défini conjointement avec la TI, le droit et la conformité avec zéro conformité matérielle, la protection de la vie privée ou les incidents d'IA responsables dans l'ensemble du portefeuille. Critères essentiels
• Baccalauréat en informatique, sciences des données, génie ou un domaine technique connexe requis. Diplôme avancé (MS, MBA, ou équivalent) préféré.
• Une vaste expérience progressive de l'IA, de la transformation numérique et de la stratégie technologique, avec une expérience éprouvée de la définition et du leadership de la stratégie d'IA pour une fonction ou une unité commerciale majeure, y compris la propriété de l'investissement, le portefeuille et la réalisation de valeur.
• Forte expérience en matière de prestation de solutions d'IA de qualité de production, d'IA générative ou d'analyse avancée dans un environnement complexe, avec une propriété démontrable des résultats commerciaux.

• Expérience éprouvée en matière de création et de direction d'équipes de professionnels de l'intelligence artificielle, des données ou de la technologie, y compris des collaborateurs principaux.
• Capacité de fonctionner de façon crédible au niveau de la haute direction - conseiller et informer les dirigeants de la C-suite sur la stratégie, le risque et la valeur de l'IA - avec une expérience de fond menant des partenariats interfonctionnels dans les domaines de la TI, du droit, de la conformité, de l'approvisionnement et des fonctions opérationnelles.
• Expérience directe en partenariat ou en travail au sein des fonctions Affaires générales, Communications, Affaires publiques, Politiques ou Gestion de la réputation, avec une compréhension approfondie de la façon dont ces fonctions créent et protègent la valeur de l'entreprise. • Produits pharmaceutiques, soins de santé ou autre industrie mondiale hautement réglementée

Gamma di insalata: CHF126,000.00 - CHF234,000.00 Descrizione del lavoro La nostra ambizione a Novartis è di essere un leader riconosciuto in Dati, Analytics, AI & Platforms (DAP). All’interno delle Piattaforme di Marketing, DAP sta creando un nuovo team di prodotti della piattaforma di contenuti per implementare e gestire piattaforme che supportano il viaggio di contenuti end-2-end per l’internazionale, la regione e i paesi (IRC) per supportare e guidare le attività commerciali, mediche e di valore e di accesso. Descrizione del lavoro Amministratore associato, Piattaforma dei contenuti dei proprietari di prodotti #LI-Hybrid # Ubicazione: Basilea, Svizzera Rilocazione: Non supportato Novartis si propone di essere leader riconosciuto in Dati, Analytics, AI & Platforms. All'interno delle Piattaforme di Marketing, il team sta costruendo una capacità di prodotto della piattaforma di contenuti per supportare il viaggio end-to-end dei contenuti in team internazionali, regionali e nazionali. Ciò include l'attivazione di attività commerciali, mediche e di valore e di accesso attraverso soluzioni di piattaforma scalabili e business-relevant. Come Direttore associato, Proprietario del prodotto, Piattaforma dei contenuti, possiederai i risultati dei prodotti per un'area di funzionalità definita, come Pianificazione, Autorizzazione, DAM/MLR o Distribuzione. Combinate il pensiero strategico del prodotto con la leadership di consegna pratica, aiutando a trasformare le esigenze aziendali in priorità chiare, soluzioni pratiche e valore misurabile. Principali responsabilità
• Contribuisci alla visione del prodotto, agli obiettivi, alla definizione del valore e alla roadmap per l'area di capacità assegnata.
• Tradurre le esigenze di business in epics chiari, caratteristiche, storie utente e criteri di accettazione, supportati da analisi di business dove necessario.
• Possedere e dare priorità al backlog del prodotto, assicurando la consegna è allineato con i risultati aziendali e le esigenze degli utenti.
• Prendere decisioni quotidiane del prodotto, gestire i trade-off di consegna e sostenere la gestione della dipendenza tra le squadre.
• Condurre la validazione delle funzionalità e la proprietà della qualità, assicurando soluzioni conformi agli intenti aziendali, alle aspettative di usabilità, ai requisiti di conformità e agli standard normativi.
• Sostenere l'adozione agendo come risorsa di materia tematica di fiducia, fornendo formazione pratica e raccogliendo feedback degli utenti per informare il miglioramento continuo.
• Collabora con i Customer Success Manager per sviluppare materiali di formazione, cartelle di gioco e guida best practice.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con le parti interessate di dati, analisi, AI & Data Science, CLS, Medical, Value & Access, IRC, S&G, DDIT, BSI e team commerciali.
• Monitorare le prestazioni del prodotto, l'adozione e la consegna dei KPI, identificare le opportunità per migliorare il valore della piattaforma e l'esperienza dell'utente.
• Resta aggiornato con tendenze emergenti e migliori pratiche nelle piattaforme di marketing e nella tecnologia dei contenuti. Requisiti
• Una laurea è preferito, idealmente con una laurea avanzata in economia, tecnologia o un campo correlato.
• Tipicamente 7+ anni di esperienza lavorando in un team di sviluppo del prodotto.
• Tipicamente 5+ anni di esperienza con piattaforme di contenuti, tecnologia di marketing o ecosistemi DAM preferiti.
• Dimostrata esperienza di gestione e priorità backlog in ambienti complessi e interfunzionali.
• Capacità di scrivere storie utente chiare e dettagliate e criteri di accettazione.
• Esperienza di lavoro con squadre distribuite in regioni e fusi orari.
• Stile di lavoro collaborativo, con la capacità di collegare le esigenze aziendali, l'esperienza utente e la consegna tecnica.
• L'esperienza con il nome di contenuti, marketing o piattaforme commerciali è anche apprezzata, tra cui Wrike, Monday.com, ScreenDragon, Aprimo, Veeva PromoMats, Activator, Shaman, Veeva CRM e Salesforce Marketing Cloud. Vantaggi e premi A Novartis, ci impegniamo a riimmaginare insieme la medicina e a premiare le persone che lo fanno accadere. Within Marketing Platforms, DAP is setting up a new content platform’s product team to implement and manage platforms which support the end-2-end content journey for international, region and countries (IRC) to support and drive the commercial, medical and value & access activities. Job Description Associate Director, Product Owner Content Platform #LI-Hybrid Location: Basel, Switzerland Relocation: Not Supported Novartis aims to be a recognised leader in Data, Analytics, AI & Platforms. Within Marketing Platforms, the team is building a content platform product capability to support the end-to-end content journey across international, regional and country teams. This includes enabling commercial, medical, and value and access activities through scalable, business-relevant platform solutions. As Associate Director, Product Owner, Content Platform, you will own product outcomes for a defined capability area, such as Planning, Authoring, DAM/MLR, or Distribution. You will combine strategic product thinking with hands-on delivery leadership, helping turn business needs into clear priorities, practical solutions and measurable value. Key Responsibilities
• Contribute to the product vision, objectives, value definition and roadmap for the assigned capability area.
• Translate business needs into clear epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria, supported by business analysis where needed.
• Own and prioritise the product backlog, ensuring delivery is aligned with business outcomes and user needs.
• Make day-to-day product decisions, manage delivery trade-offs and support dependency management across teams.
• Lead feature validation and quality ownership, ensuring solutions meet business intent, usability expectations, compliance requirements and regulatory standards.
• Support adoption by acting as a trusted subject matter resource, delivering hands-on training and gathering user feedback to inform continuous improvement.
• Partner with Customer Success Managers to develop training materials, playbooks and best-practice guidance.
• Work closely with stakeholders across Data, Analytics, AI & Data Science, CLS, Medical, Value & Access, IRC, S&G, DDIT, BSI and commercial teams.
• Monitor product performance, adoption and delivery KPIs, identifying opportunities to improve platform value and user experience.
• Stay current with emerging trends and best practices in marketing platforms and content technology. Requirements
• A university degree is preferred, ideally with an advanced degree in business, technology or a related field.
• Typically 7+ years of experience working in a product development team.
• Typically 5+ years of experience with content platforms, marketing technology or DAM ecosystems preferred.
• Demonstrated experience managing and prioritising backlogs in complex, cross-functional environments.
• Ability to write clear, detailed user stories and acceptance criteria.
• Experience working with distributed teams across regions and time zones.
• Collaborative working style, with the ability to connect business needs, user experience and technical delivery.
• Experience with named content, marketing or commercial platforms is also valued, including Wrike, Monday.com, ScreenDragon, Aprimo, Veeva PromoMats, Activator, Shaman, Veeva CRM and Salesforce Marketing Cloud. Benefits & Rewards At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen. • Typiquement 5+ ans d'expérience avec les plateformes de contenu, la technologie de marketing ou les écosystèmes DAM préféré.

Salary Range: CHF122,500.00 - CHF227,500.00 Job Description Summary Job Title: Senior Principal Scientist/Principal Scientist I/II, Oncology (RLT) #LI-Onsite Location: Basel, Switzerland Relocation Support: This role is based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support: please only apply if accessible. Shape the future of cancer treatment by driving innovative radioligand therapies from discovery to clinic. As a scientific leader within our Oncology Drug Discovery team in Basel, you will lead cutting-edge preclinical research, designing impactful in vivo studies and collaborating across global, multidisciplinary teams to unlock the potential of next-generation cancer treatments. This role offers a unique opportunity to combine scientific excellence with leadership—mentoring talent, influencing strategy, and translating complex data into meaningful insights that accelerate life-changing therapies for patients worldwide. Job Description Key Responsibilities
• Design and lead in vivo studies supporting preclinical evaluation of radioligand therapies
• Drive efficacy, biodistribution, imaging, and mechanism of action studies across oncology programs
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to advance drug candidates toward clinical development
• Manage external partnerships with contract research organizations and academic collaborators
• Mentor, guide, and develop scientists to strengthen scientific and professional capabilities
• Present data and insights clearly to influence decisions across global research and development teams Essential Requirements
• Doctor of Philosophy in Pharmacology, Cell Biology, or a related biomedical discipline
• Minimum three years of additional experience in biomedical research within academia or industry
• Strong background in cancer biology with a proven track record of scientific achievement
• Extensive experience designing and managing in vivo oncology studies, including efficacy and pharmacokinetic assessment
• Expertise in ex vivo analysis methods such as flow cytometry, immunofluorescence, immunohistochemistry, or RNA sequencing
• Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary and global research teams
• Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, both written and verbal
• Self-motivated, proactive, and able to independently drive scientific projects forward Desirable Requirements
• Experience in radioligand therapy development or radiobiology
• Strong understanding of drug development within oncology or related therapeutic areas This is a dual level posting. The final level and title for this position will be determined following the completion of the candidate evaluation process, based on skills, experience, and organizational needs Switzerland Accessibility and accommodation Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to all individuals. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, or in order to receive more detailed information about the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mail to diversity.inclusion_ch@novartis.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please include the job requisition number in your message. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support: please only apply if accessible. Shape the future of cancer treatment by driving innovative radioligand therapies from discovery to clinic. As a scientific leader within our Oncology Drug Discovery team in Basel, you will lead cutting-edge preclinical research, designing impactful in vivo studies and collaborating across global, multidisciplinary teams to unlock the potential of next-generation cancer treatments. This role offers a unique opportunity to combine scientific excellence with leadership—mentoring talent, influencing strategy, and translating complex data into meaningful insights that accelerate life-changing therapies for patients worldwide. Job Description Key Responsibilities
• Design and lead in vivo studies supporting preclinical evaluation of radioligand therapies
• Drive efficacy, biodistribution, imaging, and mechanism of action studies across oncology programs
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to advance drug candidates toward clinical development
• Manage external partnerships with contract research organizations and academic collaborators
• Mentor, guide, and develop scientists to strengthen scientific and professional capabilities
• Present data and insights clearly to influence decisions across global research and development teams Essential Requirements
• Doctor of Philosophy in Pharmacology, Cell Biology, or a related biomedical discipline
• Minimum three years of additional experience in biomedical research within academia or industry
• Strong background in cancer biology with a proven track record of scientific achievement
• Extensive experience designing and managing in vivo oncology studies, including efficacy and pharmacokinetic assessment

Job Description Summary #LI-Hybrid Location: Basel This role is based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support for this role: please only apply if this location is accessible for you. We are Clinical Sciences and Innovation at Novartis. A dynamic group of Clinical Trial Leaders (Clinical Scientists) who plan and execute early phase trials worldwide. From First-in-Human to ph2a studies and beyond. We design and operationalize trials, ensuring they run smoothly, on time and – most importantly – with patients’ interests to the fore. Curious, unbossed and inspired; we are committed to flexibility in the workplace. As a member of our team, you will support or lead the clinical science and operations of planning and executing translational medicine clinical trials. Collaborate across our global network. Partner with outstanding physicians and scientists. Build therapeutic area expertise. Revolutionize next-generation, digital and patient-centric trial design. Be always curious, innovative and inspiring. This position will be located at the Novartis Headquarter in Basel and will not have the ability to be located remotely. This position may require up to 5% travel time as defined by the business. Job Description Key Responsibilities :
• Operationally and scientifically lead complex clinical studies
• Drive and deliver aspects of global clinical trial execution from study design, set-up and recruitment to final reporting
• Lead the matrix-management of robust global clinical trial teams, collaborating across the organization and externally with service providers/investigator sites
• Drive the development of clinical study protocols, clinical operations execution plans and other required documents
• Ensure quality conduct and document standards are applied across the clinical trial lifecycle
• Lead clinical data review ( Sr. Clinical Sciences Trial Leader )
• Support clinical data review ( Clinical Sciences Trial Leader )
• Contribute to project/program level plans ( Sr. Clinical Sciences Trial Leader )
• May mentor junior team members
• Support optimization of standard methodologies in clinical trial operations and adopt an open learning and sharing environment
• Unleash the value of data and digital within clinical studies Ultimately, YOU will help bring new technologies and therapies closer to our patients Essential Requirements :
• A minimum of BSc in life sciences is required. A MSc, PharmD or PhD is desired.
• Clinical Sciences Trial Leader : 2-4 years’ experience, in clinical trial management/operations, coupled with a broad knowledge of the drug development field; preferably within the pharma industry.
• Sr. Clinical Sciences Trial Leader 4+ years’ experience in clinical trial management/operations, coupled with a broad knowledge of the drug development field; preferably within the pharma industry.
• Clinical Sciences Trial Leader level: Leadership potential and well-developed interpersonal skills.
• Sr. Clinical Sciences Trial Leader level: Demonstrated leadership experience and well-developed interpersonal skills.
• A track record of collaborating with and influencing a wide range of people, and of building strong partnerships
• Strong project management experience; excellent planning, prioritization and organizational skills; used to managing multiple priorities concurrently
• High change agility, thriving in an open and dynamic environment.
• Able to learn proactively, tackle issues and take accountability
• Clear written and verbal expression of ideas; an active communicator Desirable Requirements:
• Experience in study design and protocol development/writing is highly desirable This is a dual posting. The final level & title of the offer role would be determined by the hiring team based on the skills, experience & capabilities required to perform the role at the level the role has been offered. Accessibility and accommodation: Novartis is committed to working

descriptionByLocale.it:
Salary Range: CHF169,400.00 - CHF314,600.00 Job Description Summary Join us in a high-impact leadership role at the forefront of Oncology drug development. As Senior Global Program Safety Team Lead, you will bring clinical insight, strategic thinking, and strong leadership to complex safety decisions, helping shape development pathways and advance medicines that could change patients’ lives. Job Description Key Responsibilities
• Manage an efficient and successful disease area within the Therapeutic Area (TA)/Development Unit (DU) Medical Safety organization, which provides robust medical and science-driven contribution to BenefitRisk evaluation throughout product lifecycle to enable Novartis to provide impactful medicines to patients worldwide
• Enhance scientific and clinical experience of Medical Safety physicians / scientists through continuous training and coaching. Prepares safety objectives and evaluates and manages performance of the Medical Safety associates within the TA/DU. Identifies talents and high potential associates and is able to defend and discuss in front of leadership team. Together with associates identifies carrier development opportunities and support associates in the carrier path
• Provide expert safety input to the clinical development program for assigned projects/products and be an active member of the Global Program Team (GPT), Global Clinical Team (GCT) and Clinical Trial Team (CTT) -Is responsible for safety issue management from formation of Global Program Team (GPT) through Life Cycle Management
• Responsible for overall signal detection, monitoring, evaluation, interpretation and appropriate management of safety information, based on information from all relevant line functions, post-marketing data, and other sources
• Responsible for documentation/tracking/record keeping of the assigned compounds medical safety activities and for responses to inquiries from regulatory authorities or health care professionals on safety issues
• Leading the preparation of the safety strategy for health authority responses and strategy, in collaboration with other project team members
• Contribute to and often leading the development of departmental and functional/business unit goals and objective Essential Requirements
• Medical Degree or equivalent (preferred), PhD, PharmD or equivalent graduate level health care professional degree required. Specialty Board certification desirable
• Minimum 5 years clinical experience postdoctoral
• At least 7 years progressive experience in drug development in a major pharmaceutical company (of which 5 years in a global position), including 5 years in safety at a medical position
• Solid expertise in preparing or contributing to preparation of clinical safety assessments and regulatory reports/submissions involving safety information – to include NDA submission documents
• Substantial experience in leading cross-functional, multicultural teams
• Strong experience with (safety or others) issue management
• Extensive experience in drug development, clinical trial methodology, regulatory requirements, scientific methodology, statistics and writing of publication
• Strong leadership skills including coaching; motivating and directing, and fostering teamwork. Ability to develop and maintain effective working relationships with subordinates, superiors and peers Languages:
• Fluent English (both spoken and written) is required. Additional languages are an advantage. Beneficial skills and knowledge:
• Post graduate degree in Pharmaceutical Medicine; Master of Public Health in Epidemiology (or equivalent)
• Strong negotiation and conflict management skills
• Strong experience with medical writing and delivering high quality documents such as RMPs, PSURs This is your opportunity to lead at the forefront of Oncology development and influence the future of patient safety on a global scale. Apply now to join Novartis and help bring transformative therapies to

descriptionByLocale.it:
Salary Range: CHF164,500.00 - CHF305,500.00 Job Description Summary Location: Multiple Location Opening, please apply to the location preferred. #LI-Hybrid The Head, AI Product Management & Program Delivery leads the end-to-end execution of the Development AI product portfolio, ensuring successful delivery from MVP through scale and steady-state operations, with a strong focus on adoption readiness and measurable business value. The role is accountable for establishing and running a high-performing product management and program delivery system, including operating model, governance, and delivery standards, to ensure consistent, predictable execution across a complex AI portfolio. In alignment with strategic direction, portfolio priorities, and governance decisions defined by the Head of Development AI and relevant leadership forums, the role translates agreed priorities into integrated product roadmaps, ensuring dependencies, sequencing, and cross-product alignment are actively managed at portfolio level. . The role drives coherence and contributes to shaping the product and business capability platform layer across AI solutions, ensuring reuse, rationalization, and consistency of user experience, while aligning with strategy and governance direction. The role ensures AI products are delivered in a manner that enables adoption, scaling, and integration into business processes, working closely with Line Functions who retain accountability for value realization. This is an enterprise-level leadership role responsible for building a high-performing organization and enabling scalable delivery capability across Development. Job Description Responsibilities:
• Define and continuously evolve the AI Product Management and Program Delivery operating model, including governance, methodologies (e.g., product lifecycle), and delivery standards across Development
• Ensure high-quality execution of the AI product portfolio against agreed priorities and roadmaps, translating strategic direction into actionable delivery plans
• Establish and maintain strong delivery alignment with LFs, DDIT, and key stakeholders, ensuring clarity on execution ownership, dependencies, and interfaces
• Drive portfolio-level delivery oversight, including progress tracking, risk management, dependency management, and escalation of critical issues
• Lead the mobilization and oversight of cross-functional program structures (e.g., Tiger Teams) for priority AI initiatives, ensuring delivery at pace and scale
• Oversee resource planning and allocation across the AI portfolio, ensuring optimal deployment of product managers, program leads, and delivery capacity
• Monitor execution performance across AI products and programs, ensuring consistency, predictability, and adherence to defined delivery standards
• Ensure AI products are delivered in a manner that enables and embeds business transformation, including integration into workflows, process changes, and new ways of working, in close collaboration with Line Functions.
• Drive cross-product integration and coherence across the portfolio, actively managing dependencies, sequencing, and opportunities for reuse and rationalization at the product and business capability level

descriptionByLocale.it:
Salary Range: CHF164,500.00 - CHF305,500.00 Job Description Summary Location: Multiple Location Opening, please apply to the location preferred. #LI-Hybrid The Head, AI Strategy & Governance is responsible for maintaining, operationalizing, and continuously improving the Development AI strategy, governance model, and decision-support processes in partnership with the Head of Development AI and senior leadership. The role enables and drives strategic decision-making for the AI portfolio, ensuring that priorities, investments, and capability evolution are consistently informed by robust competitive intelligence, external benchmarking, and market signals. Acting as the central strategic integrator across Development, DDIT, and enterprise AI bodies, the role ensures that governance forums, portfolio recommendations, and enterprise interfaces are well-run, evidence-based, and aligned, while final strategy, investment, and governance decisions remain with accountable senior leaders and decision forums. Job Description AI Strategy, Competitive Intelligence & Strategic Positioning
• Maintain and evolve the Development AI strategic narrative, planning materials, and strategic priorities in partnership with the Head of Development AI
• Establish and continuously mature a structured competitive intelligence capability (external benchmarking, competitor tracking, regulatory and technology landscape monitoring)
• Synthesize competitive intelligence into actionable strategic insights to support leadership decision-making
• Prepare decision materials enabling leadership trade-offs across AI initiatives based on value, risk, and competitive positioning
• Monitor changes in the external landscape and recommend updates to strategic priorities, assumptions, and focus areas
• Provide clear strategic visibility to senior leadership through structured updates and decision support AI Portfolio Strategy & Value Governance
• Maintain portfolio prioritization principles, decision frameworks, and evaluation criteria used by leadership to make investment decisions
• Integrate competitive intelligence, external benchmarks, and innovation signals into portfolio recommendations
• Coordinate portfolio reviews and prepare recommendations on priorities, sequencing, and trade-offs
• Maintain the value governance framework, including methods for defining, measuring, and assessing AI impact
• Track and report portfolio-level progress, decision follow-through, and value realization for leadership forums AI Governance & Risk Oversight (Strategic)
• Maintain and continuously improve the Development AI governance framework, processes, and maturity roadmap in partnership with accountable leaders.
• Ensure alignment of governance approach with enterprise frameworks, regulatory expectations, and Responsible AI standards.
• Monitor governance effectiveness, risk themes, and compliance signals, and escalate issues to accountable decision-makers.
• Clarify governance roles, responsibilities, and forum interfaces to support effective decision-making and accountability AI Operating Model & Organizational Design
• Maintain and refine the Development AI operating model, including governance processes, decision interfaces, and role clarity
• Document and socialize decision rights, escalation paths, and accountability structures
• Coordinate interfaces across Strategy, Governance, Product & Program Delivery, DSAI, DDIT, and enterprise AI teams
• Recommend operating model improvements to support scale, clarity, and execution effectiveness Governance Bodies & Enterprise Liaison
• Run and coordinate AI governance forums within Development, including agenda-setting, decision preparation, documentation, and follow-through
• Serve as key liaison to enterprise AI Office, Trailblazer, and company-wide governance bodies
• Coordinate Development inputs into enterprise AI discussions and communicate outcomes back to stakeholders
• Support leadership by ensurin
